title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer (Hybrid in Bangalore)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
Automation is the key to creating highly reliable and secure large-scale software systems. Are you someone who engineers solutions to problems rather than simply fixing the same thing over and over again? Can you protect Smartsheet against attackers?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior DevSecOps Engineer**
to join our global Security Operations team. In this critical role, you will be a leader in maturing our security and reliability posture by treating both as software engineering challenges. You will engineer and operate a highly reliable, scalable, and defensible production environment, directly impacting our ability to deliver a world-class service to our customers 24/7. This is a unique opportunity to blend deep expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and modern Security Operations, working at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and security to build a platform that is resilient and secure by design.
  
  
**You Will**

* Engineer Secure and Resilient Infrastructure: Design, build, maintain, and improve secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure in our multi-cloud environment (primarily AWS) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Automate Proactive Security: Engineer and automate threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management processes. You will build the tools and workflows that allow us to respond to threats at machine speed.
* Secure the Software Development Lifecycle: Architect and secure our CI/CD pipelines, integrating automated security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA) to provide developers with fast, actionable feedback.
* Master Container Security: Manage, operate, and secure our container orchestration platform (Kubernetes), implementing best practices for container security from the registry to runtime, including knowledge of hardening requirements such as CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIG.
* Lead Incident Response: Act as a technical lead during security and reliability incidents, driving resolution and conducting blameless post-mortems to engineer preventative solutions.
* Drive Automated Compliance: Implement and automate technical controls to ensure continuous compliance with frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, and ISO 27001.
* Mentor and Lead: Serve as a subject matter expert for security and reliability, mentoring other engineers and championing a culture of operational excellence and security ownership across the organization.

**You Have**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in technology, with at least 5 years in a hands-on senior role such as Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Security Engineering.
* A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* Expert-level proficiency in at least one major cloud provider, preferably AWS, with deep knowledge of core infrastructure and security services.
* Expert-level proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform.
* Expert-level proficiency in a scripting or programming language such as Python, Go, or Ruby, with a proven history of building automation and custom tooling.
* Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes), including securing containerized environments.
* Proficiency with the modern security operations toolchain, including SIEM, EDR, and vulnerability scanning technologies.
* Experience integrating security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA) into CI/CD pipelines.
* A critical thinker with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex problems in high-pressure production environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a collaborative spirit. This will include fluency in English.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or cloud-specific security certifications.
* Experience with compliance frameworks like FedRAMP, ISO27001, SOC2.

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

title: Member of Technical Staff 2
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a curious, hands-on DevSecOps Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of cloud and developer platforms through AI, automation, and engineering innovation.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys asking questions such as:
  
  
“Why are we doing this manually?”
  
  
“Can we automate this?”
  
  
“Can AI help us understand or operate this system better?”
  
  
“Is there a better open-source technology or engineering approach we should explore?”
  
  
You do not need to know every technology we use. We care deeply about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, experimentation, and your ability to learn quickly.
  
  
You will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, security, observability, and AI-assisted operations. You will have opportunities not only to operate platforms, but also to research new approaches, build prototypes, automate repetitive work, and turn successful ideas into production capabilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds and operates platforms that enable engineering teams to deliver software securely, reliably, and efficiently.
  
  
We are evolving traditional DevOps toward a platform engineering and AI-assisted operations model. Our goal is to reduce repetitive operational work, improve developer experience, increase reliability and security, and use AI and automation wherever they can create meaningful engineering leverage.
  
  
We value engineers who are willing to experiment, challenge existing approaches constructively, share what they learn, and take ownership of making things better.
  
  
**Your Role**
**As a DevSecOps Engineer, You Will**

* Build, improve, and automate CI/CD workflows for application and infrastructure delivery.
* Work with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes to deploy and operate scalable services.
* Develop automation using Python, Go, Bash, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Identify repetitive operational activities and convert them into reliable automation or self-service capabilities.
* Explore how AI, LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation can improve troubleshooting, observability, incident response, infrastructure management, and developer productivity.
* Participate in technical research and proof-of-concepts, evaluate emerging technologies and open-source projects, and present recommendations based on your findings.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using tools such as Terraform and other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
* Improve observability through metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and intelligent analysis of operational data.
* Integrate security into software delivery through vulnerability scanning, dependency management, secrets management, policy enforcement, and secure engineering practices.
* Troubleshoot production and platform issues and use those experiences to identify opportunities for permanent engineering improvements.
* Contribute to platform documentation, architecture discussions, engineering standards, and reusable automation.
* Collaborate with application, security, SRE, platform, and AI/ML engineering teams.
* Continuously learn new technologies and share your experiments, findings, successes, and failures with the broader team.

**What You Will Bring**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 2–6 years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, software engineering, or a related area.
* Good understanding of Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, containers, and software delivery fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container technologies, or a strong demonstrated interest in developing deeper expertise in this area.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and technologies.
* Ability to write useful automation using Python, Go, Bash, or another programming/scripting language.
* Understanding of source control and modern software development practices.
* Basic understanding of application, infrastructure, container, or software supply-chain security.
* Experience working with monitoring, logging, or observability technologies.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
  
  
--

* Architect, scale, and continuously improve the reliability, availability, and performance of JumpCloud’s multi-region microservices, APIs, and authentication infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
  
* Architect, build, and maintain Disaster Recovery (DR) process, multi-region failover automation, and business continuity strategies to ensure rapid recovery against strict RTO and RPO objectives.
  
* Lead the design and enforcement of SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budget frameworks across multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
  
* Drive end-to-end observability strategy using Datadog, implementing actionable Golden Signals monitoring to drastically reduce MTTD/MTTR and eliminate alert fatigue.
  
* Lead on-call escalation, major incident management, and drive strict adherence to 99.99% availability SLAs.
  
* Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews, executing systemic root-cause remediations to prevent recurring failure modes.
  
* Architect, manage, and scale production Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, implementing advanced GitOps workflows (Argo CD, Kargo) and deployment patterns.
  
* Design and maintain modular, enterprise-grade Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform across multi-account, multi-region cloud environments.
  
* Design, build, and maintain interactive FinOps and cost-optimization dashboards to provide engineering and leadership teams with actionable insights into multi-cloud spend, unit economics, and resource utilization.
  
* Eliminate complex operational toil by writing production-grade Python or Go tooling, platform automation, and custom integrations.
  
* Champion AI-assisted software development workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate automation, runbook creation, and incident triage across the team.
  
* Author operational runbooks, architecture decision records, and mentor mid-level/junior engineers to raise the overall technical bar.
  
  

  
**We’re Looking For:**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering operating 24/7 mission-critical, highly available distributed systems.
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.
  
* Strong Python/Go Capabilities: Advanced software engineering skill set for writing internal SRE platforms, tools, and API integrations.
  
* Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Hands-on experience with production EKS/GKE cluster lifecycles, ingress/egress, networking, RBAC, and GitOps tooling (Argo CD).
  
* Advanced IaC & AWS/GCP: Deep Terraform proficiency (module architecture, state management refactoring) across complex multi-account AWS environments (IAM, VPCs, Transit Gateway, ALB/NLB, Route53).
  
* FinOps & Cost Optimization Leadership:
  Demonstrated experience driving cloud cost-efficiency strategies, resource right-sizing, cost-allocation tagging, workload optimization, and building FinOps dashboards to embed financial accountability into engineering workflows.
  
* Disaster Recovery & High Availability: Proven background in designing and testing multi-region Disaster Recovery architectures, automating failover systems, and monitoring recovery health via DR dashboards.
  
* Observability & Reliability Architecture: Track record of defining SLI/SLOs, managing PagerDuty schedules, and optimizing production observability platforms.
  
* Experience designing and operating enterprise service meshes (Istio, Linkerd, or similar) and production ingress/proxy systems (HAProxy, NGINX, or similar).
  
* Technical Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to lead technical discussions, write architectural design docs/RFCs, and mentor engineering peers.
  
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for solving complex distributed systems challenges at scale.
  
* A strong team player who helps us live by our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day.
  
  

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

  
* Basic understanding of chaos engineering principles or testing resilience in staging/production.
  
* Experience with secrets management architectures (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, External Secrets Operator, Cert-Manager).
  
* Background in DevSecOps practices, service meshes (Istio), and automated vulnerability remediation within cloud infrastructure code.
  
* Background supporting identity services, IAM, enterprise directory platforms, or security-focused SaaS solutions.

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Lead Site Reliability Engineer leads the reliable delivery and operation of OpenText solutions, including xECM, Teamsite , OTMM and related platforms. The role combines hands-on SRE and cloud engineering with AI-assisted development, agentic automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and technical leadership.
  
  
The engineer will work across the application lifecycle—from design and provisioning through testing, migration, upgrades, patching, operations, and decommissioning—and will use AI and automation to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed, quality, and service reliability.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**
Work within an OpenText technical delivery team in order to:
  
  

* Lead the technical design, deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of OpenText solutions across on-premises and public-cloud environments.
* Apply GitHub Copilot and other approved AI-assisted engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation, and operational automation.
* Design and develop agentic AI solutions and workflows that automate repeatable engineering, deployment, support, and reliability tasks with appropriate controls.
* Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD pipelines and shared libraries for automated build, test, security validation, deployment, approvals, rollback, and release management.
* Design, deploy, and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, including cluster configuration, workload management, scaling, upgrades, security controls, observability, and troubleshooting; automate supporting cloud infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure.
* Drive observability, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, reliability improvements, upgrades, and patching; participate in on-call and planned weekend activities when required.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Tools, and Operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, review deliverables, mentor engineers, and act as Scrum Lead or technical lead when needed.

**What You Need To Succeed**
BE/B. Tech. or equivalent technical qualification
  
  
**Minimum Of 8 Years Of Relevant Experience**
Strong hands-on experience deploying, administering, automating, and troubleshooting OpenText xECM , and related components; cloud deployment experience is strongly preferred.
  
  

* AI-assisted engineering: hands-on use of GitHub Copilot or comparable approved tools for code generation, refactoring, unit tests, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Agentic AI development: ability to design and build AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows using programming languages, APIs, prompt and context design, tool integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and responsible-AI controls.
* GitLab CI/CD: practical knowledge of pipeline configuration, reusable templates and shared libraries, automated build and testing, security checks, artifact management, approvals, deployment, rollback, and release management.
* Automation and infrastructure as code: experience with Terraform, Helm, Ansible, scripting, APIs, and automation of provisioning and operational workflows.
* Kubernetes and container orchestration: strong hands-on experience deploying and supporting production workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. Skills should include pods, deployments, services, ingress, ConfigMaps, secrets, namespaces, persistent storage, resource limits, autoscaling, rolling updates, health probes, RBAC, network policies, logging, monitoring, upgrades, and root-cause troubleshooting. Exposure to managed Kubernetes services such as GKE, EKS, or AKS is preferred.
* OpenText solutions: deployment, administration, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting experience with TeamSite, LiveSite, Exstream, OTMM, xECM, Documentum, or related platforms.
* Platform engineering: working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, web and application servers, databases, and secure application operations.
* Service reliability: experience with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management in Agile or Scrum delivery environments.
* Ability to lead a small technical team, review technical deliverables, mentor engineers, and provide clear technical direction.
* Strong problem-solving, ownership, and customer-service mindset, with disciplined attention to reliability and quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
* Continuous-learning mindset and willingness to evaluate and adopt new AI, automation, cloud, and SRE practices.

**One last thing**

* Programming or scripting experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Shell, or PowerShell.
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, LDAP, object-oriented programming, and application integration patterns.
* Exposure to AI-agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps practices is an advantage.

title: Senior Engineer,  Site Reliability Engineering
description:
**Role Summary**
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll provide deep reliability and operational expertise for business-critical cloud services. You’ll help set the reliability strategy (for example, defining SLOs and error budgets), design the observability and automation that keep services balanced, and lead improvements that reduce operational risk and customer impact. This role suits people who enjoy solving complex production problems and raising the standard for engineering excellence—regardless of whether your background is SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineering with strong operations experience.
  
  
On-call: You’ll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. As a senior specialist, you’ll help improve how we run on-call by reducing noisy alerts, automating repetitive tasks, and strengthening operational readiness so incidents become less frequent and easier to resolve. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly and continuously improve the on-call experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own reliability outcomes for critical user journeys and cloud components by defining SLIs/SLOs, setting error budgets, and using data to prioritise resilience work.
* Design observability standards (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting) using tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly.
* Lead major incident response as incident commander when needed, drive blameless post-incident reviews, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and measured.
* Improve platform resilience and scalability through reliability architecture reviews, capacity and performance engineering, and proactive risk assessments.
* Reduce toil by automating repetitive operational work (for example with Terraform, CI/CD, and scripting), and track improvements through clear operational metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, Security, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, compliance obligations, and customer impact.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and change procedures, and raise standards through reviews, templates, and shared practices.
* Coach and mentor engineers, helping teams adopt SRE ways of working and strengthening operational ownership.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Significant experience in SRE/DevOps/Platform Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) supporting production services and making reliability improvements that stick.
* Demonstrated ownership of reliability practices such as SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident actions, and operational readiness.
* Strong AWS knowledge and hands-on experience operating cloud services (for example: EKS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, DocumentDB, RDS/MySQL, and CloudWatch/CloudWatch Insights).
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation (for example, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitLab CI/CD).
* Experience with Kubernetes, including production operations on managed platforms such as Amazon EKS.
* Ability to script to automate and solve (for example, Python and/or JavaScript), with an engineering approach to testing, review, and maintainability.
* Experience building actionable monitoring and alerting that balances sensitivity and noise (for example, Datadog and CloudWatch).
* Confidence presenting, staying calm during incidents, and influencing teams through data, clear writing, and pragmatic recommendations.

**Good to have Skills:**
Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, networking, security, policy, and multi-tenant considerations).
  
  
Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity modelling for cloud-native services.
  
  
Software engineering experience in Python and/or JavaScript beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews).
  
  
Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric develop, alert tuning, incident analytics).

title: Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway you will provision and operate it day to day: bringing up nodes and clusters, running upgrades, keeping the fleet consistent through GitOps, and owning your shift of the on-call rotation.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need working knowledge of all three enough to isolate where a problem lives before escalating it.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Provision bare-metal servers across multiple metros using the team's PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init pipeline, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Extend and maintain that provisioning automation as new hardware, metros and OS versions are introduced, keeping node bring-up free of manual per-node steps
* Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations
  
  

* Bring up and operate Kubernetes clusters following the team's established control-plane topology, including etcd members, kube-apiserver HA behind the L4 load balancer or VIP, and defined failure-domain placement
* Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
* Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration
  
  

* Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
* Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
* Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching
  
  

* Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
* Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
* Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
* Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
* Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
* Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
* Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
* Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
* Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
* Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
* Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
* Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
* Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
* Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
* Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
* On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
* Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

**Preferred**

* Experience with Rancher, Rancher Prime or a comparable multi-cluster management plane
* Familiarity with DPDK-based data planes such as 6WIND VSR, or with SR-IOV NIC tuning
* Exposure to SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Technical Architect- Salesforce Devops
description:
**Description**
**ROLE OVERVIEW**
The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**S**

* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.

* Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.

**PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE:**
**E**

* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
* Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
* Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
* Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
* Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
* Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
* Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
* Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

**Experience Requirements**

* 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
* 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
* Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
* Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams

AI/ML applications leverage vast amounts of data to identify insights, automate processes, and solve complex problems across a wide range of fields, including healthcare, finance, e-commerce, and more. Proficient

Advanced

Advanced

**Proficiency Level:**
Advanced

**Proficiency Level:**
Advanced

8+ years

**16,500 professionals**

Synechron is seeking a Windows Administration Specialist to support the reliability, security, and scalability of Windows-based platforms across on-premises and AWS environments.

The role will own Windows administration, patch management, automation, observability, and operational improvement. Success will be measured through improved patch compliance, reduced operational risk, reliable service performance, and increased automation.

Software Requirements

Required

* Windows Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 administration
* PowerShell scripting and automation
* Enterprise patch management using Ivanti or an equivalent platform
* AWS services, including EC2, AMIs, Systems Manager, and patch baselines
* Monitoring and logging tools such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, or Sumo Logic
* ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or equivalent
* CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite, or equivalent

Preferred

* WSUS, SCCM/MECM, or comparable patching platforms
* Terraform, CloudFormation, DSC, or Ansible
* Git-based source control and infrastructure-as-code workflows
* Linux administration fundamentals

Overall Responsibilities

* Own the full Windows patch management lifecycle, including assessment, scheduling, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Operate and optimize Ivanti or equivalent patching solutions.
* Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance checks, and operational tasks using PowerShell and IaC.
* Monitor Windows systems, investigate incidents, and resolve performance, stability, and security issues.
* Improve Windows hardening, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Support Windows workloads, build agents, and services within CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with SRE, platform, application, and security teams from design through production.
* Document standards, procedures, recovery steps, and operational decisions.
* Contribute to blameless postmortems and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Expected outcomes:**

* Consistent and measurable patch compliance
* Reduced unresolved vulnerabilities and configuration drift
* Improved system availability and incident response
* Increased automation and reduced manual operational effort
* Clear, current, and reusable technical documentation

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming and Scripting

**Essential:**

* PowerShell scripting for administration, reporting, and automation
* Basic scripting practices including error handling, logging, testing, and version control

**Preferred:**

* Python or another automation language

Databases and Data Management

**Essential:**

* Ability to review operational data, patch reports, logs, and compliance metrics

**Preferred:**

* Basic SQL knowledge
* Experience managing configuration or asset data

Cloud Technologies

**Essential:**

* AWS EC2, AMIs, Systems Manager, and patch baselines
* Windows workload management in cloud environments

**Preferred:**

* CloudFormation or Terraform
* Experience designing resilient and cost-aware cloud infrastructure

Frameworks and Libraries

**Essential:**

* Windows Server administration and Active Directory fundamentals
* PowerShell modules and Desired State Configuration concepts

**Preferred:**

* Ansible or other configuration management frameworks

Development Tools and Methodologies

**Essential:**

* CI/CD integration for Windows applications and build agents
* Git-based workflows
* Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management principles
* Incident, change, and problem management practices

**Preferred:**

* Experience with SRE practices, service-level objectives, and post-incident reviews

Security Protocols and Compliance

**Essential:**

* Windows security hardening
* Vulnerability remediation and patch compliance
* Access control, encryption, endpoint protection, and audit requirements
* Maintenance window planning and risk-based change management

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with recognized security and compliance frameworks

Experience Requirements

* Typically 7–12 years of experience in Windows Server administration, site reliability, infrastructure engineering, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience managing Windows patching at enterprise scale.
* Practical experience with Ivanti or comparable patch management platforms.
* Experience supporting production systems across on-premises and AWS environments.
* Experience automating operational tasks with PowerShell.
* Financial services or other regulated-industry experience is preferred.
* Equivalent experience gained through technical training, certifications, internships, or progressively responsible infrastructure roles may be considered.

Day-to-Day Activities

* Review system health, alerts, patch status, vulnerabilities, and operational dashboards.
* Plan and coordinate maintenance windows and patch deployments.
* Test, deploy, validate, and report on Windows updates.
* Investigate incidents, performance issues, failed deployments, and compliance gaps.
* Develop PowerShell scripts and automation for recurring tasks.
* Manage AWS-based Windows instances, images, and Systems Manager configurations.
* Participate in stand-ups, incident reviews, change reviews, and planning sessions.
* Collaborate with SREs, engineers, application teams, security teams, and service owners.
* Contribute to CI/CD improvements, documentation, standards, and operational runbooks.
* Make decisions within approved change, security, and availability controls, escalating material risks when required.

Qualifications

* Degree, diploma, or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications are preferred, such as Microsoft Windows Server, AWS, ITIL, or security certifications.
* Completion of role-relevant training in Windows administration, PowerShell, cloud operations, security, and patch management.
* Ongoing learning is expected through technical training, knowledge sharing, certifications, and hands-on experimentation.
* Ability to participate in scheduled maintenance activities or incident response, where required by the operating model.

Professional Competencies

* **Critical thinking:**
  Analyze technical evidence, identify root causes, and select proportionate solutions.
* **Problem-solving:**
  Resolve incidents systematically while reducing the likelihood of recurrence.
* **Leadership and teamwork:**
  Share expertise, mentor peers, and work effectively across disciplines.
* **Communication:**
  Explain technical risks, plans, and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Adaptability:**
  Respond constructively to changing priorities, technologies, and operating conditions.
* **Innovation:**
  Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve reliability.
* **Time management:**
  Prioritize work according to service impact, security risk, compliance deadlines, and operational capacity.
* **Operational responsibility:**
  Support sustainable practices by reducing manual effort, unnecessary infrastructure use, and repeat incidents.

The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices.
  
  
This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Reliability, Operations & Support**
Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications.
  
  
Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required.
  
  
Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews.
  
  
Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention.
  
  
Database Engineering & Administration
  
  
Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR.
  
  
Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis.
  
  
Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures.
  
  
Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers.
  
  
Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams.
  
  
Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools.
  
  
**SRE, DevOps & Automation**
Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  
  
Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes.
  
  
Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks.
  
  
Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services.
  
  
Cloud & Migration
  
  
Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure.
  
  
Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance.
  
  
Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments.
  
  
Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls.
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
  
Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies.
  
  
Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management.
  
  
Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills & Experience**
Core SRE / DevOps Skills
  
  
Demonstrable experience with SRE and DevOps practices for stateful systems.
  
  
Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/KornShell, PowerShell.
  
  
Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub/GitLab, Bitbucket, Rundeck).
  
  
Familiarity with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault).
  
  
Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm).
  
  
Database Technologies
  
  
Extensive hands-on experience with:
  
  
Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai)
  
  
RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard
  
  
Exadata, RMAN, OEM
  
  
PL/SQL, APEX
  
  
Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or PostgreSQL.
  
  
Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies.
  
  
Cloud & Platforms
  
  
Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms.
  
  
Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments.
  
  
Linux administration experience (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Solaris X86/Sparc).
  
  
**Additional Requirements**
Experience supporting critical platforms in multi datacentre or multi region environments.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate calmly under pressure.
  
  
Understanding of ITIL service management frameworks.
  
  
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
  
  
Experience in the finance or banking sector is helpful.
  
  
**Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills**
Experience with Delphix.
  
  
Exposure to ServiceNow, Control M, Citrix, or web development platforms.
  
  
Knowledge of MySQL, MongoDB, Perl scripting.
  
  
Experience with database migration tools, distributed transactions, and data warehousing platforms.
  
  
**Behavioural & Leadership Skills**
Strong influencing and partner management skills.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication at technical and business levels.
  
  
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  
  
Collaborative demeanor with a proven sense of ownership.
  
  
Proactive, self motivated, and committed to continuous improvement.
  
  
Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others.
  
  
Pragmatic and outcome-focused approach to problem solving.

title: Engineer II, DevOps Engineering
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale.
  
  
Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
The Position
  
  
This position is available in the DAIV System Team, a centralized DevOps and software infrastructure team based in Bangalore and supporting multiple software product development teams across the EMEA region. These teams develop desktop and web applications for data management, image processing, and visualization workflows. The DAIV System Team provides CI/CD infrastructure, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity support across the software development lifecycle. As a DevOps Engineer, you will contribute to the CI/CD, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity capabilities used by desktop and web product teams. Working with senior engineers and technical leads, you will implement automation, support product teams, resolve delivery issues, and build brad experience across modern DevOps technologies.
  
  
How You Will Make an Impact
  
  
You will help development teams deliver software more efficiently by maintaining reliable pipelines, automating repetitive work, and resolving build and deployment issues.
  
  
You will contribute to secure, consistent engineering practices while learning how complex desktop and web products are built, tested, packaged, and released.
  
  
You will work in an international, collaborative environment with opportunities to develop technical depth in a desktop or web application track.
  
  
In This Role You Will
  
  

* Implement, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines and supporting DevOps infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers and technical leads.
* Support product teams with build, test, packaging, deployment, release, and software lifecycle management activities.
* Create and maintain scripts, pipeline components, automation, and documentation that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support GitHub or GitLab repositories, runners or agents, artifact management, access patterns, and related developer tooling.
* Investigate build, pipeline, deployment, environment, and release failures; document findings and implement agreed corrective actions.
* Contribute to secure SDLC practices by operating automated code, dependency, container, and secrets scanning and assisting with vulnerability remediation.
* Participate in upgrades, migrations, patching, and deprecation activities for development tools, operating systems, build environments, containers, and platform components.
* Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers, software engineers, architects, cybersecurity specialists, and product stakeholders to deliver prioritized improvements.
* Follow engineering standards, review processes, configuration management practices, and operational procedures.
* Share knowledge, seek feedback, and continuously develop technical skills across the supported technology stacks.
* Participate in Agile planning, team reviews, and continuous improvement activities.

The Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a practical and curious software or DevOps engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a strong learning mindset, and the discipline to build reliable, maintainable automation.
  
  
Besides that, you have:
  
  

* Bachelor's or master's degree with 3 to 6 years of DevOps industry experience.
* Preferred fields of study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience with software development or DevOps fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, scripting, automated testing, and systematic troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Git and at least one CI/CD platform such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD, including basic pipeline maintenance and artifact or package management.
* Experience with several of the following core technologies: Python, .NET, Docker, and Linux.
* Exposure to at least one application track is beneficial: desktop delivery using CMake, C++/Qt, PowerShell, and Windows build environments; or web delivery using Kubernetes, Helm, Rancher, and containerized application platforms.
* Understanding of software security principles and secure SDLC practices, including dependency management, secrets protection, automated scanning, vulnerability remediation, and quality controls.
* Interest in using approved generative AI capabilities responsibly to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and automation activities.
* Ability to analyze problems, follow through on technical tasks, document solutions, and learn new technologies quickly.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in cross-functional, distributed teams.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or SAFe is beneficial.
* Travel may occasionally be required for collaboration with global teams.

* Own and deliver platform workstreams end to end — lifecycle upgrades across a large multi-region cluster estate (Kubernetes, node OS, service mesh, ingress, and platform add-ons), from planning and pre-work through documentation and rollout.
* Design and improve how clusters are built and managed: GitOps-driven provisioning, cluster lifecycle automation, and standardised Helm charts consumed by development teams.
* Act as a senior escalation point in an on-call rotation for highly available enterprise-class systems, leading incident diagnosis to root cause and driving the follow-up actions.
* Partner directly with application engineering teams on resource optimisation, rightsizing, workload resiliency, and remediation of platform-level blockers.
* Strengthen container security and networking posture — runtime policy enforcement, secrets management, image supply chain, and ingress/API gateway configuration.
* Shape and maintain the Kubernetes roadmap alongside the operations leads: estimate scope, sequence work against business outcomes, and flag risk early.
* Mentor engineers on the team, review their designs and changes, and raise the bar on documentation and operational practice.
* Author and maintain runbooks, standards, and internal documentation that other engineers and development teams rely on as the source of truth.
* Complete daily operational work — change requests, troubleshooting tickets — and systematically convert recurring toil into automation.

**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience operating Kubernetes in production, including at least 2 years at scale across multiple clusters or regions (Rancher/RKE2, Tanzu, OpenShift, PCF, EKS/AKS, or upstream Kubernetes).

*Key Skills*

* Deep working knowledge of the Kubernetes ecosystem and adjacent platform tooling — ArgoCD, Kong, Vault, Traefik, NeuVector, Istio, ingress-nginx, cert-manager, Prometheus/Grafana, or close equivalents.
* Strong understanding of container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and a Kubernetes distribution such as Rancher Kubernetes Engine, including cluster upgrade and node lifecycle mechanics.
* Proficient scripting and automation skills — Bash and Python (or PowerShell/Go) — with a demonstrated track record of eliminating manual work through code, Ansible, or GitOps.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross-team technical projects independently and make sound design decisions with minimal supervision.
* Experience mentoring or technically guiding less experienced engineers.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the flexibility to adapt and meet changing demands.
* Proactive ownership within a collaborative, globally distributed environment.
* Ability to thrive under pressure in a demanding environment, with a commitment to excellence.
* Intellectually curious and prepared to challenge and be challenged.

*Desirable Skills*

* Container networking and security at depth — CNI behaviour, network policy, runtime security enforcement, TLS and certificate management.
* Cluster API / infrastructure-as-code provisioning of Kubernetes clusters on vSphere or equivalent.
* Storage integration in Kubernetes (CSI drivers, NetApp, Dell, or similar).
* Monitoring, alerting, and logging at scale — Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, Elasticsearch or Graylog — including alert routing and noise reduction.
* CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practice, including GitHub Actions.

*Personal Characteristics*

* Proactive and results-oriented with a passion for achieving goals and driving excellence within the team.
* High degree of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail, integrity, and accountability.
* Willingness to work flexible hours across time zones and take ownership of challenges as they arise.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer - SRE
description:
Introduction
  
  
**Job title: Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Experience: 5-10 years**
**The opportunity**
You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud. These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this cloud and SRE role, you will own their reliability: defining and meeting SLOs, responding fast to incidents, troubleshooting end to end, and engineering out recurring problems through automation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key responsibilities**
We are seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our growing team. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Own the reliability of business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud, used 24/7 by warehouses and stores.
* Define and track SLIs and SLOs with product and application teams, using error budgets to balance reliability and release speed.
* Build observability (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts) using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix.
* Provide 24/7 L2/L3 support, act as incident commander on major incidents, and lead root cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Troubleshoot end to end across Cloudflare, HAProxy, network, Linux, Docker, Apache TomEE/Java, APIs, and Oracle Database, and quickly isolate the failing layer.
* Diagnose Java application issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, GC logs, and APM traces.
* Perform first-level Oracle Database triage and escalate to the DBA team with clear diagnostics.
* Build and deploy cloud infrastructure (networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, FastConnect) using Terraform and Ansible.
* Automate away toil, such as deployments, health checks, failover, and routine maintenance, with Python and Bash.
* Plan capacity, tune performance, and test high availability and disaster recovery through regular failover drills.
* Plan and execute production changes with minimal downtime and tested rollback, and maintain runbooks.

**Key criteria**
**Must-have**

* 5-10 years in SRE, cloud infrastructure, or production operations, including at least 3 years running production workloads on Azure or OCI.
* Strong cloud expertise (Azure or OCI) across networking (VNet/VCN, VPN, ExpressRoute/FastConnect), compute, storage, and IAM.
* Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience.
* Hands-on Terraform, Ansible, and Python/Bash automation in production environments.
* Practical SRE experience: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, 24/7 incident management, and blameless post-incident reviews.
* Experience with observability and APM tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic).
* End-to-end troubleshooting across networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS), HAProxy or similar load balancers, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, REST APIs, and Oracle Database at triage level.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift and on-call model.

**Good-to-have**

* Cloud certifications (Azure, OCI, or AWS).
* Experience with Cloudflare (DNS, WAF, CDN, caching rules).
* CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) with canary or blue-green releases.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Chaos engineering or game-day exercises to test resilience.
* GPU-based compute supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Retail or supply chain domain exposure, ITIL familiarity, and strong written and verbal communication.

**Growth opportunities**

* Learning opportunities with multi-cloud environments.
* Scope to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud (OCI) and Azure in large production environments.
* Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, multi-cloud, DevOps, orchestration tools, scripting, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future.

**About Us**
**Our values**
Our values guide how we work with our customers and with each other.
  
  

* Customer focus
* Innovation at speed
* Targeted focus
* Team unity

**Join us**
SymphonyAI is a global leader in Vertical AI platforms. Our Eureka AI platform helps enterprises solve their most complex, high-value challenges across retail and consumer goods, financial services, industrial, and enterprise IT.
  
  
Our retail division helps retailers and CPG manufacturers drive profitable growth with AI-powered solutions for demand forecasting, merchandising, supply chain, and store operations. Learn more at www.symphonyai.com.
