title: Technical Architect- Salesforce Devops
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity. Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team. This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window. The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**S**

* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
* Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
* Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
* Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub's Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
* Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
* Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
* Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
* Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub's deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
* DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
* Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
* Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
* Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub's DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
* Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
* Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
* Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
* Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
* Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
* Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
* Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
* Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
* Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.

**PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE:**
**E**

* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
* Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
* Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
* Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
* Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
* Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
* Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
* Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

**Experience Requirements**

* 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
* 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
* Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
* Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
* Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I (Required)
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (Required)
* Salesforce Certified DevOps Engineer (Required)
* Salesforce Application Architect (Preferred)
* Copado Fundamentals I & II (Preferred)
* Gearset Certified (Preferred)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

Release Engineers work across the full software delivery lifecycle — from CI/CD and containerization to cloud infrastructure and release governance — and act as a trusted point of support for engineering teams across the company via the group's dedicated support channels.
  
  
This is a hybrid role: part software engineer, part cloud/infrastructure engineer, and part release governance owner. Expectations scale with seniority — from being autonomous in your own work, to leveraging your knowledge to help the team hit its goals, to guiding others and balancing technical, business, and operational needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* CI/CD ownership: Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions workflows) that power build, test, and deployment automation across OutSystems services.
* Container & image management: Maintain and secure the Docker base-image catalogue (ingestion, versioning, deprecation, scanning) and manage AMI/machine-image pipelines (Packer, EC2 Image Builder) for build and CI infrastructure.
* Cloud infrastructure: Manage and provision cloud resources across AWS (ECR, EC2, IAM/OIDC) and Azure (ACR, Azure DevOps), using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform via Spacelift).
* Versioning & packaging: Own semantic versioning and package management practices (GitVersion, SemVer, NuGet feeds) to keep releases consistent and traceable.
* Release governance: Operate release governance processes, including RFC/CAB change management, deployment gating, and rollback procedures for production changes.
* Operational support: Staff the Release Engineering support rotation, triaging and resolving developer requests and incidents raised through dedicated support channels.
* Monitoring & metrics: Build and maintain observability into pipelines and deployments using tools such as Grafana, Power BI, and Kibana.
* Security & compliance: Uphold security and compliance standards (SOC 2 and FedRAMP controls, vulnerability scanning via Wiz/Snyk) across the release pipeline.
* Leadership & enablement: As seniority grows, guide other engineers, mentor teams adopting CI platform/release best practices, and represent Release Engineering's roadmap to stakeholders across the company.

Skills You Need to Succeed
  
  
Skills below are ranked by how central they are to day-to-day Release Engineering work. Must-haves are used constantly and span nearly every squad; good-to-haves add significant value but are more specialized or team-specific and can often be developed on the job.
  
  
**Must Haves**

* CI/CD pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions — designing, debugging, and maintaining build/release workflows.
* OCI Lifecycle: Development and management of the full life cycle of OCI artifacts.
* Cloud platform fundamentals: AWS (ECR, IAM/OIDC, EC2, RDS) and Azure (ACR,Azure Machines and DBs, Azure DevOps) core services.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Image Building: Proficiency in Terraform, CloudFormation for cloud provisioning and experience with Packer and EC2 Image Builder are must-have skills.
* Ownership under pressure: A strong sense of urgency, customer focus, and reliability as a support point for other engineering teams.

**Good To Haves**

* Git workflows & semantic versioning: Branching strategies, tagging, GitVersion/SemVer discipline, and NuGet/npm feed mechanics.
* Observability & monitoring: Hands-on experience designing, building, and managing end-to-end monitoring and alerting systems to gain operational insights across pipelines and platform components (e.g., using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Power BI, or Kibana).
* Security & vulnerability scanning: Working knowledge of security practices, vulnerability scanning, and compliance standards such as SOC 2 and FedRAMP.
* Release & change governance: RFC/CAB processes and staged (ring-based) promotion models for production changes.
* GitOps & Kubernetes: Flux-based GitOps repositories and Helm release troubleshooting across multiple environment rings.
* Cross-team mentoring & leadership: Experience mentoring other engineers or representing a team's roadmap to stakeholders

More about OutSystems
  
  
OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.
  
  
As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.
  
  
OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.
  
  
Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.
  
  
Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.
  
  
Working at OutSystems

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Role: DevOps Engineer**

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Department:**
Platform Engineering / DevOps

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**About Styli Marketplace**

Launched in 2019 by Landmark Group, Styli Marketplace is the first e-commerce venture of the group, quickly becoming a leading online destination for fashion and lifestyle across the GCC, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and beyond. Styli connects global sellers and creators with millions of fashion-forward customers, offering the latest trends, exceptional value, and convenient services like same-day to 48-hour delivery and flexible payment options. Our mission is to make style accessible, aspirational, and exciting for all, backed by a passionate team fostering a culture of creativity and innovation. At Styli, we aim to revolutionize fashion retail and bring unique experiences to our customers.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a skilled and ownership-driven
**DevOps Engineer**
to join our Engineering team. You will design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and delivery pipelines that power Styli's commerce platform on GCP. This is a hands-on role with high autonomy — you will own critical systems, drive automation, and work closely with product engineering teams to ensure we ship fast and stay reliable.

**What You'll Do**

**Cloud Infrastructure (AWS & GCP)**

* Design, provision, and maintain production-grade infrastructure across
  **AWS**
  (primary) and
  **GCP**
  , including compute, networking, storage, and managed services.
* Architect and manage multi-region, highly available environments with a focus on
  **fault tolerance and cost efficiency**
  .
* Own IAM strategy, VPC design, security groups, service mesh configurations, and cross-cloud networking (VPN / Interconnect / Transit Gateway).
* Drive cloud cost optimization through right-sizing, reserved instance planning, Spot/preemptible workload strategies, and tagging governance.
* Manage cloud-native services: EKS, GKE, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, Cloud Spanner, Pub/Sub, SQS/SNS, CloudFront, and more.

**Kubernetes & Container Orchestration**

* Build and operate production
  **Kubernetes clusters**
  on GKE with a strong focus on reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Design workload scheduling strategies including autoscaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA), node pool management, and pod disruption budgets.
* Implement and maintain
  **Helm charts**
  , Kustomize overlays, and GitOps-based delivery workflows (ArgoCD / Flux).
* Enforce cluster security: RBAC, network policies, OPA/Kyverno admission control, image signing, and secrets management (Vault / AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager).
* Manage service mesh (Istio / Linkerd) for traffic management, observability, and mTLS between services.

**Scaling & Performance Engineering**

* Design and implement
  **horizontal and vertical scaling strategies**
  to handle traffic spikes — including sale events, campaign launches, and seasonal peaks.
* Build and tune
  **auto-scaling pipelines**
  across cloud instances, Kubernetes workloads, and managed services to ensure zero downtime under surge conditions.
* Profile infrastructure bottlenecks in collaboration with backend engineering; drive resolutions across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Establish and monitor capacity plans with defined headroom SLOs for all critical services.

**CI/CD & Developer Experience**

* Design and maintain robust, fast
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins — supporting microservices, containerised builds, and multi-environment promotion.
* Build internal developer platforms and golden paths that enable engineering teams to deploy with confidence and speed.
* Implement progressive delivery patterns:
  **blue-green deployments, canary releases, and feature flags**
  with automated rollback.
* Own build optimisation — caching strategies, parallelisation, and pipeline observability to reduce feedback cycle times.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Author and maintain all infrastructure using
  **Terraform**
  (primary) and Pulumi/CDK where appropriate — with state management, module registries, and policy-as-code.
* Automate operational tasks and toil elimination using
  **Python, Bash, or Go**
  .
* Maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, staging, and production environments.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* **5–8 years**
  of hands-on DevOps / Platform / Infrastructure Engineering experience.
* Strong working knowledge of
  **GCP**
  — GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and GCP networking fundamentals.
* Expert-level
  **Kubernetes**
  operations: cluster lifecycle management, workload scheduling, autoscaling, RBAC, and networking (CNI, Ingress, Service Mesh).
* Proficiency in
  **Terraform**
  for multi-cloud IaC — module design, state management, and CI/CD-integrated plan/apply workflows.
* Hands-on experience with
  **CI/CD tooling**
  : GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent.
* Strong scripting skills in
  **Python and/or Bash**
* Solid understanding of
  **Linux systems administration**
  , networking (DNS, TLS, TCP/IP, HTTP/2), and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience designing for
  **high availability and scale**
  — load balancing, stateless service design, caching layers, and database connection management.

**Good to Have**

* Experience running infrastructure for
  **high-traffic e-commerce events**
  (flash sales, product launches, or festive season scaling).
* Familiarity with
  **FinOps practices**
  and cloud cost attribution models.
* Experience with
  **service mesh**
  (Istio or Linkerd) in production.
* Knowledge of
  **container security**
  hardening: image scanning, runtime protection (Falco), admission controllers.
* Experience with
  **data platform infrastructure**
  : Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or dbt on cloud.
* Relevant certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Professional, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA/CKAD.

**The Scale You'll Work At**

* **Millions of active users**
  across multiple countries in the Middle East such as Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and Oman.
* **High-concurrency commerce events**
  — flash sales and campaign launches driving 10x–20x baseline traffic.
* **Microservices**
  deployed across multi-region Kubernetes clusters.
* **Cloud architecture**
  hosted in GCP (primary) and with a focus on regional proximity to end users.

title: Sr. Kubernetes Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
**About The Technology Organisation**
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
**About The Business Function**
The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialised engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a Sr. Kubernetes Engineer, you will design, build, and operate Lilly's Kubernetes-based hosting platform across multiple clouds. You will own platform capabilities end to end: writing Kubernetes controllers in Go and platform automation in Go or Python, defining infrastructure as code, evolving CI/CD and GitOps delivery, and raising the reliability and security of the platform.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Build, deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters end to end, from provisioning and configuration through upgrades, networking, scaling and decommissioning, on a managed offering such as EKS or ROSA, or an equivalent platform.
* Develop and maintain custom Kubernetes controllers and operators in Go (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK), including CRD design, reconciliation logic, finalizers, and admission webhooks.
* Author and maintain automation, tooling, and services in Go or Python that streamline platform operations, onboarding, and review processes.
* Build and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize, with strong module design, state management, and policy-as-code practices.
* Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps pipelines using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Artifactory, and Checkmarx, with a security-first approach to software supply chain.
* Implement node and workload autoscaling with Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, HPA/VPA, and KEDA, including node image and upgrade strategies.
* Partner with application teams during onboarding, migration, and go-live, providing hands-on technical guidance and clear documentation.

How You Will Succeed
  
  

* Demonstrate deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, API machinery, and troubleshooting production issues.
* Write production-quality Go (and Python where needed), including tests, and apply good software engineering practices to platform code.
* Apply strong knowledge of AWS/Azure, including compute, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, private endpoints), IAM (IRSA, Pod Identity, workload identity), and managed Kubernetes services.
* Operate CI/CD and GitOps toolchains effectively, with sound judgment on release strategies such as progressive delivery, canary, and rollback.
* Use observability tooling to diagnose platform and application issues quickly, and drive improvements from the findings.

What You Should Bring
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4-7 years of experience in Platform or DevOps engineering, including running Kubernetes in production.
* Strong, hands-on experience with at least one managed Kubernetes offering (EKS, AKS, ROSA, or ARO); exposure to multiple is strongly preferred.
* Strong programming experience in Go, including hands-on experience building Kubernetes controllers and operators; Python for tooling and automation is a plus.
* Solid knowledge of Kubernetes internals and extension points: CRDs, controllers and operators, admission webhooks, finalizers, and the client-go and controller-runtime libraries.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps tooling: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management (Artifactory or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure core services, networking, and IAM.
* Practical experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir, or equivalents) and log analysis in Splunk or similar.
* Experience with Linux, containers, and container runtimes, and strong troubleshooting skills across the network and OS layers.

Additional Information
  
  
This is a full-time employee position. Availability for flexible hours may be needed to support platform operations, and some on-call or non-standard-hours support may be required depending on platform incident volume.
  
  
Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer - IaaS
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - IaaS builds and runs the IaaS Platform and Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as DevOps, Cloud Engineering / Architecture
* Deep expertise in Windows Server and/or Linux Operating Systems
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Azure, AWS, and GCP certifications
* undefined
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
API Management, Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevSecOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Specialist System Engineering - DevOps Engineer — AI & Pipeline Automation
description:
**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that support 5G NF application deployment from lab environments through production with repeatable, secure, and automated promotion workflows.
* Develop AI-assisted pipeline automation capabilities that use LLMs to analyze build failures, deployment issues, pipeline health, and operational telemetry.
* Build and maintain MCP servers and AI-callable tool integrations that expose Azure, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, repository, and deployment capabilities through controlled automation interfaces.
* Create self-healing pipeline workflows that can detect common failure patterns, trigger approved remediation steps, and provide clear diagnostics, confidence levels, and escalation paths.
* Partner with client project teams to understand delivery requirements, architect CI/CD solutions, and implement automation patterns aligned with enterprise DevOps standards.
* Develop reusable YAML templates, pipeline components, scripts, and automation libraries that standardize CI/CD delivery across applications, environments, and teams.
* Integrate pipeline workflows with source control, artifact repositories, approvals, environment gates, testing frameworks, security checks, and release governance processes.
* Support Kubernetes-based deployments by troubleshooting deployment failures, configuration issues, container readiness, service health, and environment-specific pipeline behavior.
* Implement observability for CI/CD systems, including pipeline metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, failure trend analysis, and continuous improvement feedback loops.
* Apply secure DevOps practices for secrets handling, access control, policy enforcement, code review, vulnerability checks, and audit-ready release execution.
* Create AI-assisted root-cause analysis tools and knowledge workflows that help engineering teams quickly identify probable causes and recommended next actions.
* Lead technical discussions, working sessions, demos, and hands-on training to improve DevOps maturity and enable client teams to adopt AI-enabled pipeline automation.
* Document architecture, operating procedures, automation patterns, troubleshooting guides, and standards to ensure consistent adoption and long-term maintainability.
* Continuously evaluate emerging DevOps, GenAI, LLM, and MCP capabilities and recommend practical enhancements that improve delivery speed, quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.

**Job Qualifications / Required Qualifications**
Linux & Scripting Fundamentals
  
  

* Expert-level Linux experience with strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, and/or PowerShell
* Proven ability to automate manual processes using scripting languages and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Ansible)
* Hands-on experience containerizing, deploying, debugging, and maintaining applications

Azure DevOps & Pipeline Engineering
  
  

* Expert ability to build ADO Pipelines from the ground up using YAML
* Proficiency with az cli commands within ADO Pipelines to interact with Azure Resources
* Deep understanding of ADO Repos including branching, tagging, and environment management strategies
* Working knowledge of ADO Agents – their purpose, capabilities, and limitations
* Strong use of JSON and YAML as data formats across scripts, Ansible playbooks, and pipelines

Azure Platform & Infrastructure
  
  

* Experience with Azure Container Registry (ACR) to import, tag, and extract images and charts within pipelines
* Understanding of Azure Resource Manager, Endpoints, and Service Principals
* Ability to build Azure Resources using Bicep and ARM Templates with emphasis on parameterization
* Familiarity with Azure Key Vault (AKV) and Hashi Corp Enterprise Vault (HCEV) for secrets management
* Experience with Azure Operator Service Manager (AOSM)

Kubernetes & Container Orchestration
  
  

* Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and debugging workloads on Kubernetes (AKS preferred)
* Proficiency with kubectl for inspecting pods, logs, events, and resource states during pipeline-triggered deployments
* Ability to diagnose and resolve common deployment failures including CrashLoopBackOff, image pull errors, resource quota issues, and failed health probes
* Experience integrating Kubernetes deployment steps into ADO Pipelines including rollout strategies, namespace management, and environment promotion
* Familiarity with Helm charts for packaging and deploying applications through pipelines
* Understanding of Kubernetes RBAC, service accounts, and their role in secure pipeline-based deployments

AI & LLM Integration
  
  

* Hands-on experience integrating Azure OpenAI or equivalent LLM APIs into automation workflows
* Ability to design prompts for pipeline analysis, failure summarization, and root-cause diagnosis
* Familiarity with agent-based AI patterns including tool/function calling and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Experience designing and building custom MCP servers to expose internal APIs and data as AI-callable tools

Pipeline Intelligence & Analysis
  
  

* Ability to leverage ADO REST APIs to surface pipeline health metrics, flaky tests, and failure patterns
* Experience building AI-assisted workflows for root-cause analysis against pipeline logs
* Capability to design self-healing pipeline logic - detect, diagnose, remediate, and re-trigger

Communication & Collaboration
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to articulate complex technical concepts, solutions, and standards to stakeholders across varying skill levels - through both presentations and discussions
* Collaborative approach to working across platform, security, and application engineering teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics and Communication, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated experience building enterprise-grade Azure DevOps pipeline automation using YAML, reusable templates, environment gates, approvals, and automated release promotion workflows.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into DevOps workflows for build failure analysis, pipeline summarization, root-cause diagnosis, and recommended remediation.
* Experience designing or operating MCP servers, AI-callable tools, function-calling frameworks, or controlled automation interfaces that interact with Azure, ADO, repositories, Kubernetes, or internal APIs.
* Practical experience with self-healing or intelligent automation that detects recurring failure patterns, triggers approved remediation actions, and provides diagnostics with clear escalation paths.
* Strong working knowledge of Kubernetes-based application deployments, Helm charts, container registries, kubectl troubleshooting, rollout strategies, and secure service account/RBAC practices.
* Experience using Azure services such as Azure Container Registry, Azure Key Vault, Service Principals, ARM/Bicep templates, Azure CLI, and Azure Operator Service Manager within automated delivery pipelines.
* Familiarity with observability and pipeline intelligence practices, including pipeline health metrics, log analysis, flaky test detection, dashboards, alerts, and continuous improvement feedback loops.
* Exposure to GenAI patterns such as prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, tool/function calling, agentic workflows, and responsible use of AI guardrails in automation scenarios.
* Ability to lead technical working sessions, document standards and operating procedures, and train client or engineering teams on AI-enabled DevOps pipeline automation.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GitHub Copilot extensibility or custom AI agents.
* Familiarity with vector databases and Azure AI Search for embedding-based workflows.
* Prior work building AI-powered DevOps dashboards or reporting tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes-native observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

**Additional Job Information**
This is an offshore role that requires daily collaboration with U.S. stakeholders, including overlapping work hours to ensure effective partnership and meet business needs.

Regular

title: Sr. SW Engineer (Python, Jenkins, Github, Devops, Change Management, 3-6 years)
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to join the Platform Engineering organization. The role will focus on application onboarding, deployment automation, production release support, platform modernization, operational excellence, and engineering productivity initiatives.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with development teams, SREs, architects, and platform teams to enable secure, scalable, and compliant deployments across cloud-native environments while driving automation and reducing operational friction.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Platform Engineering & Application Onboarding
  
  

* Support onboarding of applications to the enterprise deployment platform.
* Assist development teams in adopting platform standards, deployment patterns, and operational best practices.
* Enable modernization initiatives including containerization and cloud-native deployments.

Release & Deployment Management
  
  

* Support production and non-production deployments across multiple applications and environments.
* Coordinate release activities, implementation plans, validation activities, and rollback procedures.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues and drive resolution during implementation windows.

Automation & Engineering Productivity
  
  

* Develop automation scripts and tools to improve deployment efficiency and operational reliability.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline enhancements and deployment standardization initiatives.
* Automate repetitive operational processes and improve observability.

Infrastructure & Middleware Support
  
  

* Support Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateway, certificate management, and connectivity-related activities.
* Assist with provisioning, configuration validation, and operational troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with infrastructure teams to resolve platform dependencies.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
* Contribute to operational runbooks, deployment procedures, and knowledge management.
* Monitor application health and support production stability initiatives.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Support vulnerability remediation and security-driven platform improvements.
* Ensure deployments and operational activities comply with organizational standards and controls.
* Participate in audit and compliance-related activities when required.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Bare Metal Kubernetes Platform
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.
  
  
This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.
  
  
You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure
  
  

* Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
* Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention
* Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane & Worker Nodes
  
  

* Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones
* Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node
* Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD & Data Plane Deployment
  
  

* Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates
* Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network
  
  

* Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation
* Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS & Kubernetes Upgrades
  
  

* Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change
* Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live
* Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane
  
  

* Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes
* Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call & Incident Management
  
  

* Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events
* Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting
* Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months
  
  

* Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps
* Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion
* Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration
* OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks
* etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
* Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane
* Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* OS & bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening
* Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement
* Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management
* Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling
* CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet
* Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it
* Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet
* Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage
* On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response
* Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one
* SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation
* SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
* Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

title: Staff / Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Company Overview:**
Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
  
  
BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
  
  
We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

**Responsibilities**

* ****Establish and evolve SRE best practices****
  across the organization, including reliability principles, error budgets, incident response, postmortems, and operational readiness standards.
* ****Define and drive observability strategy****
  for system health, performance, and reliability, including SLIs/SLOs, alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators.

  **software-driven solutions within the infrastructure domain**

  , architecture guidance, and high-quality design and code reviews for engineers across infrastructure and product teams.

  **documentation and knowledge sharing**
  , ensuring systems and processes are well-understood and not dependent on individual ownership.
* Participate in and help mature
  **incident response**
  , escalation practices, and post-incident learning across the organization.

**Desired Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale.

**Reliability & Troubleshooting**

* Expert-level, methodical troubleshooting across the
  **entire stack**
  , from application to kernel to network.
* Strong command-line proficiency and deep expertise in
  **Linux systems and operating system fundamentals**
  .
* Advanced understanding of networking concepts including
  **load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service-to-service communication**
  .

**Software & Automation**

* Experience working across multiple languages (e.g.,
  **Python, Go, Bash**
  , and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar).
* Strong track record of
  **automating repetitive and complex operational work**
  to reduce toil and increase reliability.
* Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that
  **standardize and scale engineering practices**
  .
* Comfortable operating in an
  **agile environment**
  , with disciplined testing and quality practices.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

* Deep experience with cloud platforms (
  **AWS preferred**
  , GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production-grade architectures.
* Strong expertise in
  **Kubernetes and container orchestration**
  (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices.
* Proven experience designing and implementing
  **observability systems**
  , including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
* Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and
  **microservices architectures**
  .
* Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts.

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Experience designing and maintaining
  **company-wide IaC codebases**
  using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
* Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.

**Why Join Us:**
It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced DevOps erve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, assessing DevOps maturity, identifying capability gaps, recommending improvement opportunities, and guiding teams through the implementation and adoption of approved standards, practices, and enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own and advance a designated DevOps capability domain, defining its implementation patterns, adoption strategy, technical direction, roadmap, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Serve as the primary DevOps Capability Representative and subject matter expert for assigned product teams, providing technical leadership, standards guidance, architecture direction, and capability adoption support.
* Lead DevOps excellence evaluations by establishing maturity baselines, assessing current-state capabilities, defining and tracking key performance indicators, performing gap analyses, measuring progress against target-state objectives, and recommending improvement opportunities.
* Lead DevOps capability adoption across product teams by assessing current-state maturity, identifying capability gaps, establishing implementation backlogs, defining roadmaps, and driving adoption of enterprise DevOps standards.
* Perform application, platform, and team readiness assessments to identify technical, operational, process, skills, and capability gaps. Conduct gap assessments against enterprise cloud requirements, engineering standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and DevOps standards, and define remediation plans to address identified deficiencies.
* Lead the planning and execution of DevOps transformation and implementation initiatives, including roadmap development, backlog establishment, work prioritization, effort estimation, resource planning, budget forecasting, and day-to-day delivery coordination.
* Assign, lead, and support DevOps Engineers embedded within product teams to accelerate capability adoption, standards implementation, platform modernization, and delivery improvements.
* Ensure all engagements include structured coaching, mentoring, knowledge transfer, documentation, and capability enablement activities that increase team self-sufficiency and reduce long-term dependency on embedded DevOps support.
* Establish clear engagement objectives, success criteria, transition plans, and exit criteria that enable operational ownership to be successfully transferred to product teams once capabilities have been adopted.
* Provide low-level solution architecture and low-level cloud architecture guidance, ensuring applications, platforms, delivery pipelines, and operational practices remain aligned with enterprise standards, architecture principles, and strategic technology direction.
* Design, review, and contribute Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application deployment specifications, automation scripts, and reusable implementations that improve scalability, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Lead and promote observability and monitoring practices that improve visibility into application and platform health, reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness.
* Integrate security controls and tooling into development pipelines and partner with engineering teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Apply and promote DevOps good practices, industry standards, enterprise architecture principles, and approved engineering patterns across product teams and platforms.
* Define and promote standard implementation patterns, ensuring teams leverage approved enterprise platforms, shared services, and reusable capabilities whenever practical and appropriate.
* Track delivery milestones, capability adoption progress, implementation outcomes, and team objectives, proactively identifying risks and driving corrective actions when required.
* Perform code reviews, architecture reviews, standards compliance reviews, and change-control assessments to identify quality, security, reliability, and compliance gaps.

title: Senior DevOps Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a DevOps Lead to own our DevOps and DevSecOps strategy across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will set the technical direction for infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, and security. You will lead a team of engineers and make sure our platforms are scalable, resilient, secure, and compliant.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership and Strategy**

* Define and own the DevOps, DevSecOps, and platform engineering roadmap.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DevOps/SRE engineers, setting standards for code review, on-call, and incident management.
* Partner with engineering, security, product, and leadership on architecture, capacity planning, and cost optimization (FinOps).
* Own vendor and tooling decisions, budgets, and build-vs-buy evaluations.

**Infrastructure and Automation**

* Architect and govern scalable CI/CD pipelines for on-prem, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and hybrid environments.
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code adoption (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi) with reusable modules, state management, and drift detection.
* Lead container orchestration strategy with Docker and Kubernetes, including multi-cluster and multi-region setups.
* Design and operate hybrid workloads using orchestrators such as Anthos or Azure Arc.

**DevSecOps and Security**

* Embed security into the SDLC with SAST, DAST, SCA, container and IaC scanning, secrets management, and SBOM/supply-chain security (SLSA, image signing).
* Implement Zero Trust architecture, IAM least-privilege, encryption (at rest and in transit), key management, and network segmentation.
* Enforce policy-as-code using OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or HashiCorp Sentinel.
* Run risk assessments, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and patch governance with defined remediation SLAs.
* Own compliance readiness and audits for ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and similar frameworks.

**Reliability and Observability**

* Establish SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
* Lead incident response, postmortems, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including regular failover testing with defined RTO/RPO.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, with at least 4 years leading teams or platforms.
* Deep expertise across on-prem infrastructure and at least two of AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Expert scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, or Go.
* Production experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD, CircleCI) and GitOps practices.
* Strong command of networking, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, and load balancing.
* Proven DevSecOps track record: Zero Trust, IAM, PKI, encryption, auditing, and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA).
* Experience designing large-scale Kubernetes platforms in production.
* Strong stakeholder communication, including the ability to present risk and strategy to senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: CKA/CKS, AWS DevOps Professional, AWS/Azure Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP.
* Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd), eBPF-based security tooling, and runtime protection (Falco).
* Experience with security tooling such as Vault, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, and Wiz/Prisma Cloud.
* Experience leading cloud migrations or on-prem to hybrid transformations.
* Exposure to FinOps and platform-as-a-product practices.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker who stays hands-on when needed.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills under pressure.
* Clear communicator who builds trust across engineering and security teams.
* Passion for automation, resilience, and secure-by-design systems.

**What We Offer**

* A modern cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure stack.
* Real ownership and influence on platform and security strategy.
* Health benefits, flexible work options, and the latest hardware.
* A growth path toward Head of Platform, Director of Engineering (Infrastructure), or Principal Architect.

title: Devops Engineer-On-prem
description:
**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
RZR is seeking a high-caliber Kubernetes & Platforms Engineer to join our Bangalore engineering hub. This role is the backbone of our container orchestration strategy, critical for the design, scaling, and management of the infrastructure powering our programmatic Demand-Side Platform (DSP).
  
  
You will transition our high-performance Real-Time Bidding (RTB) environment into a world-class, cloud-native ecosystem. Leveraging Kubernetes (K8s), Docker/Containerd, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi), you will ensure our bidding services operate with sub-millisecond latency and massive horizontal scalability. You will collaborate with global SRE and Backend teams to bridge the gap between bare-metal performance and cloud-native agility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cluster Orchestration: Design, deploy, and maintain production-grade Kubernetes clusters across on-prem (bare metal) and hybrid cloud environments.
* Container Networking: Optimize K8s CNI plugins (e.g., Cilium, Calico) to handle high-throughput RTB traffic with minimal overhead.
* GitOps & Automation: Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure declarative, reproducible infrastructure.
* Performance Engineering: Fine-tune container runtimes and resource quotas (CPU/Memory pinning) for latency-sensitive applications.
* Observability: Implement deep-stack monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger to trace requests across microservices.
* Security & Policy: Enforce cluster security using Network Policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, and automated vulnerability scanning for container images.

**Required Skills / Experience**

* Professional Experience: 3+ years in DevOps/SRE (6+ for Senior roles) with a heavy focus on containerization.
* Kubernetes Mastery: Deep internal knowledge of K8s components (Etcd, API Server, Scheduler) and CRD development.
* Linux Systems: Strong proficiency in Linux internals (namespaces, cgroups, eBPF) and shell scripting.
* Infrastructure as Code: Expert-level experience with Terraform or Pulumi.
* Service Mesh: Practical experience with Istio or Linkerd for traffic management and mTLS.
* Programming: Proficiency in Go (preferred for K8s operators) or Python.
* Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related technical field.
