Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.
  
  
At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise infrastructure and application delivery platforms across both on-premises and hyperscaler cloud environments. This role will be responsible for driving DevOps practices, CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), platform reliability, and operational excellence in hybrid infrastructure landscapes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in cloud and data center technologies, automation, container platforms, and production support. This individual will partner closely with Infrastructure, Application Development, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available technology solutions.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**DevOps, Platform Engineering & Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain enterprise DevOps platforms supporting software development and infrastructure teams.
* Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines utilizing Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, or equivalent technologies.
* Automate application deployment, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, patching, and operational workflows.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on deployment speed, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

**On-Premise Infrastructure Operations**

* Support enterprise data center infrastructure including virtualized environments, compute, storage, networking, and backup solutions.
* Manage Linux-based environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Integrate on-premises systems with cloud platforms to support hybrid operational models.
* Participate in infrastructure lifecycle management, upgrades, patching, disaster recovery testing, and capacity planning.

**AI & Frontier Technology Platform Support**

* Deploy, automate, and support AI/ML infrastructure platforms and services in cloud and on-premises environments.
* Support AI engineering teams with scalable environments for model training, inference, experimentation, and deployment.
* Manage infrastructure supporting generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI copilots, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks.
* Establish operational monitoring, security controls, compliance, and reliability standards for AI solutions.

**Hybrid Cloud & Hyperscaler Support**

* Design, deploy, and support workloads across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Manage and optimize hybrid cloud environments integrating on-premises infrastructure with cloud services.
* Support cloud governance, security standards, identity management, cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Partner with cloud vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex platform issues.
* Develop cloud migration, modernization, and platform engineering strategies.
* Design and support containerized application platforms using Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS, EKS, or GKE.
* Manage cluster administration, networking, security, scalability, and operational health.

**Monitoring, Reliability & Production Support**

* Implement and maintain enterprise monitoring, logging, and observability solutions.
* Support production systems with a focus on availability, performance, and resiliency.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and on-call support rotations.
* Develop operational runbooks and support procedures for critical platforms.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to improve system availability and reduce operational risk.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and resiliency initiatives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Operations.
* Strong experience supporting both on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based environments.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Jenkins administration, pipeline development, automation, and integration.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins and Azure DevOps
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code Ansible.
* Strong Linux administration experience.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration platforms.
* Experience supporting Azure or GCP environments.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-cloud experience across Azure and GCP.
* Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect or related certifications.
* Experience managing large-scale hybrid cloud transformations.
* Knowledge of platform engineering and self-service infrastructure models.
* Experience supporting retail, distribution, supply chain, or large-scale customer-facing platforms.

**Core Competencies**

* DevOps & Platform Engineering
* Jenkins Administration & CI/CD Automation
* Hybrid Cloud Operations
* Hyperscaler Cloud Support (Azure, GCP)
* On-Premises Infrastructure Management
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes & Container Platforms
* Enterprise Monitoring & Observability
* Automation & Continuous Improvement

**Circana Behaviors**
Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:
  
  

* Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
* Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
* Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
* Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
* Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
* Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
* Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

**Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore, Karnataka, India (Hybrid).**
*An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.*

This is a hands-on role: you will write the Terraform, the pipelines and the automation that make the platform repeatable, secure and cost-effective at scale.

Your work will directly enable our Analytics and AI teams to build the future of global language services. If you enjoy designing systems that other engineers depend on, you'll find a home here.

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager (OpenSearch)
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
NetApp is looking for Technical Operations Manager to join our growing NetApp Instaclustr team in India. NetApp’s Instaclustr offering provides open source as-a-service company, delivering reliability at scale. We manage cutting edge open-source technologies (OpenSearch, Kafka, Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Valkey, Postgres, ClickHouse and Cadence) for our customers around the world.
  
  
NetApp Instaclustr makes it easy for our customers to run powerful open-source applications at the highest levels of scale. We have developed a platform that takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production. Since being founded in 2013, Instaclustr has grown strongly, with over 300 customers worldwide, and over 30,000 nodes under management.
  
  
Our Technical Operations Engineers are the frontline team keeping our large fleet of cloud-hosted open-source clusters up and running. Your work will ensure the security, reliability and performance of world-class systems and databases. You will collaborate with our customer’s technical teams, from globally recognised companies in the gaming, banking and logistics industry sectors, ranging from big multinationals to emerging start-ups.[
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
As TechOps Manager, you will be a leader in our TechOps team who maintain and support our large fleet of cloud-hosted Apache OpenSearch and Kafka open-source technology clusters. Every day will raise interesting and challenging problems ranging across many different areas such as fleet management, customer support, incident response and team development. Based from our Bangalore, office, you will be working closely with other teams, including Product Management, Development Teams and Customer Success to help drive and shape the way we support our customers.
  
  
**Duties and Activities:**

* Maintain an understanding of our product offerings (OpenSearch and Apache Kafka) as well as working knowledge of Instaclustr systems.
* Lead a team of talented engineers to deliver a very high quality of customer service and outcome. Including performance reviews and other people management activities.
* Reviewing the teams work demands and support requests daily, prioritizing them and ensuring timely responses are provided to the customer
* Ensuring that customer issues are responded to within SLA timeframes through staff training, ongoing queue management, allocation of appropriate resources.
* Project management of major operational tasks such as cluster migrations and fleetwide upgrades. This includes resource allocation and scheduling.
* Participate customer calls in different geographies related to the management of major operations
* Be aware of conflicting fleetwide operations and manage these appropriately to eliminate risk (e.g. fleet upgrades targeted to clusters under migration).
* Ensuring that defined processes and procedures are adhered to.
* Manage Shift Rostering
* Participate in our Level 3 on-call roster (Major Incident Manager) which includes rotating weekend coverage and contribute to post incident activities.
* Provide training to new team members and customers in TechOps operational procedures, and ensure these processes are adhered to.
* Be a proactive, reliable and supportive member of the TechOps team.
* Identify and drive the implementation of opportunities to continuously improve TechOps activities through the development and
* Maintenance of tools and procedures and/or working closely with the product engineering team.

Education
  
  

* We require you to have the right skills and maintain professional qualifications for the role covering:
* Proven experience in a Technical Lead capacity, with a clear interest in pursuing a Technical Manager career path, or recent experience in a Technical Manager role. Should have 8+ years of overall experience.
* Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and professionally in written and verbal English is essential as this role will involve customer interaction.
* Ability to perform the role as Major Incident Manager
* Demonstrated excellent experience with managing teams in challenging environments and take measures to keep the team morale high, drive positive work culture
* Previous system administration and/or programming experience is preferred
* Demonstrated ability to multitask, this is a critical attribute to have in this role

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
  
  
**Our culture**
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

title: Windows Administration Specialist — SRE Team
description:
**SRE Team**
We are responsible for ensuring our platform remains stable, scalable, and resilient. The SRE team bridges the gap between development and operations — breaking down silos, empowering developers, and fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  
  
Within this mission, the Windows Administration Specialist plays a critical role in maintaining the health, security, and automation of our Windows-based platforms and services.
  
  
We build creative, automated, and robust solutions to operational challenges, working as generalists who partner with product and engineering teams from the earliest design stages through to production reliability and optimization.
  
  
We see the big picture — defining standards, enabling consistency, and cultivating an agile, learning-oriented culture. We follow SRE principles such as blameless postmortems, operational load limits, and continuous feedback loops to ensure system reliability and team well-being.
  
  
Above all, we’re passionate about automation, observability, and constant learning — thriving in an environment where no two days are the same.
  
  
**As a Windows Administration Specialist, you will:**

* Enlighten, enable, and empower multidisciplinary teams by providing deep Windows platform expertise across multiple environments.
* Design, build, and maintain highly available and secure Windows Server environments in both on-premises and AWS ecosystems.
* Own and execute Windows patch management lifecycle, including assessment, scheduling, deployment, validation, and reporting.
* Operate and optimize Ivanti (or equivalent) patching solutions to ensure timely vulnerability remediation and compliance.
* Automate Windows provisioning, configuration, patching, and compliance using PowerShell and infrastructure-as-code approaches.
* Identify, prioritize, and resolve performance, stability, and security issues across Windows workloads.
* Establish observability best practices for Windows systems, including event monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
* Partner with SREs, platform engineers, and application teams to improve reliability of Windows-hosted services.
* Improve CI/CD integration for Windows-based applications, build agents, and supporting services.
* Drive continuous improvement in Windows hardening, patch posture, and vulnerability management.
* Champion operational excellence by documenting standards, mentoring peers, and promoting automation-first thinking.

**In short — automate, secure, and patch all the Windows things.**
**Here’s What You Need:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022).
* Proven experience managing Windows Server patching at scale in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with Ivanti patch management (highly desirable) or similar enterprise patching platforms (WSUS, SCCM/MECM, etc.).
* Solid understanding of patch compliance, vulnerability remediation, and maintenance window strategies.
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and operational tooling.
* Experience managing Windows workloads in AWS (EC2, AMIs, Systems Manager, patch baselines).
* Familiarity with configuration management and IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, DSC, Ansible).
* Experience integrating Windows workloads into CI/CD pipelines (Buildkite, Jenkins, or similar).
* Working knowledge of observability and logging platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, or Sumo Logic.
* Understanding of Windows security hardening and compliance frameworks.
* Strong Linux fundamentals are a plus.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools is advantageous.

* Learn the architecture of all applications to effectively troubleshoot issues and Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring high availability and reliability

* Provide basic L1 & L2 support for PROD issues and communicate with end users and Participate in PROD issue calls and assist in triaging issues.

* Ability to validate AI-assisted operational recommendations before applying changes, escalating when uncertain and following data sensitivity requirements
* Experience in DevOps and in Java, CI/CD pipeline setup, Git, BitBucket, and Jenkins and experience in continuous integration and source control tools, with experience in CI/CD pipeline setup using Jenkins.

* Experience in monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Splunk, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Prometheus) and logging solutions (e.g., AWS CloudTrail) and Experience in code management tools like GIT, BitBucket, and SVN.
* Experience in monitoring and responding to production alerts, providing L1 & L2 support, and strong problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with end users and team members and Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services.
* Advanced knowledge of application, data, and infrastructure architecture disciplines, and understanding of architecture and design across all systems.
* Ability to work in large, collaborative teams to achieve organizational goals and Passionate about building an innovative culture and understanding industry-wide technology trends and best practices.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field, preferably with a focus on Information Systems.
* Familiarity with modern technologies
* Exposure to cloud (AWS) technologies
* Exposure to Microservices

title: DevOps/ Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer / Senior DevOps Engineer

Company: DoveRunner

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 7–10 Years

Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore / Seoul, South Korea

Industry: B2B SaaS / Cybersecurity

About Doverunner

Doverunner is a leading cybersecurity company specializing in advanced application security, mobile protection, and threat mitigation solutions for digital-first businesses.

We work with enterprises across BFSI, Gaming, Fintech, and O2O ecosystems to secure applications, transactions, and customer trust at scale.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced DevOps / Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in India / Seoul. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of our automated build and deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application monitoring systems. This role requires a technically rigorous individual who can work independently, communicate findings clearly, and consistently propose improvements that raise the reliability and efficiency of our systems.

As a member of a cross-functional team, the DevOps Engineer will collaborate closely with software developers, quality assurance engineers, and product stakeholders. A working proficiency in English is required, as the role involves reading international technical documentation, communicating with external vendors, and participating in periodic cross-regional meetings.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Automation and CI/CD

* Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD
* Automate build, test, and deployment workflows to minimize manual intervention and reduce the risk of human error
* Establish and enforce GitOps practices for consistent, auditable infrastructure and application deployments
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks in existing pipelines to reduce overall build and release cycle times

Application Monitoring and Observability

* Deploy and manage monitoring, alerting, and observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, the ELK stack, or Datadog
* Define and maintain service-level indicators, objectives, and agreements in collaboration with product and engineering leadership
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks and escalation procedures for production incidents
* Lead post-incident reviews, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence
* Proactively analyze system metrics and trends to identify potential issues before they impact end users

Infrastructure Management and Infrastructure as Code

* Provision, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure using Terraform or Pulumi
* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including workload scheduling, network policy, autoscaling, and resource optimization
* Maintain configuration management tooling using Ansible or equivalent solutions
* Continuously evaluate and optimize cloud resource utilization and associated costs

Security and Compliance

* Integrate security scanning tools into CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, container image scanning, and dependency auditing
* Manage secrets, credentials, and sensitive configuration using HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or equivalent
* Ensure infrastructure and application configurations comply with internal security policies and any applicable regulatory requirements
* Apply least-privilege principles consistently across IAM roles, service accounts, and network access controls.

Continuous Improvement and Collaboration

* Regularly evaluate existing tools, processes, and architectures and present concrete recommendations for improvement
* Produce and maintain clear documentation covering infrastructure design, operational procedures, and architectural decisions
* Support development teams in improving local development environments and reducing environment-related inconsistencies
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, contributing a DevOps and reliability-focused perspective
* Communicate technical status, incident updates, and improvement proposals in English when required, both in writing and verbally

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years of professional experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or infrastructure engineering role
* Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or a comparable platform
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes in a production environment
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, or Go
* Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack
* English language proficiency sufficient for reading technical documentation and for written and verbal professional communication

Preferred

* Industry certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer
* Experience implementing GitOps workflows using ArgoCD or Flux
* Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd
* Background in chaos engineering practices and tools
* Experience managing database infrastructure and coordinating schema migrations within a DevOps workflow

Primary Technology Stack

Candidates should have experience with, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, technologies in the following areas:

* Cloud Platforms: Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure
* Containers and Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
* CI/CD and GitOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible
* Monitoring and Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, PagerDuty
* Scripting and Programming: Python, Bash, Go
* Security Tooling: Trivy, HashiCorp Vault, SonarQube
* Version Control: Git via GitHub or GitLab

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Cisco’s Enterprise AI team, the core group enabling Generative AI powered experiences across Cisco. Our mission is to build secure, scalable AI platforms that empower teams to safely develop, deploy, and operationalize AI-powered solutions. We operate at the intersection of applied AI, cloud infrastructure and security - partnering across engineering, security, compliance, and product teams to bring trusted AI to life at an enterprise scale.
  
  
We are a fast-growing, highly collaborative team of platform engineers, AI engineers, and data scientists who value technical depth, ownership, and pragmatic execution. What makes this team exciting is the opportunity to define how secure Generative AI is built and governed inside a global technology leader.
  
  
As a Senior SRE in our India hub, you will tackle complex networking and service mesh challenges across a global footprint. Your expertise in Anthos and Istio will be critical in maintaining the high-availability platform that powers Cisco's most advanced AI initiatives.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Develop and maintain Terraform scripts to provision and manage scalable GCP and On-premise Kubernetes resources and Docker containers.
* Configure and optimize Anthos Service Mesh (ASM) and Istio for service-to-service communication, security, and observability.
* Implement and audit IAM roles and GCP Quotas, ensuring the environment is "Secure by Design" with robust encryption and secrets updates.
* Build and leverage observability dashboards using Elasticsearch and Kibana to monitor system health and provide proactive alerts on performance and cost.
* Execute capacity planning and scaling for new feature rollouts, ensuring the environment stays within defined cost envelopes and security standards.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud/On-prem Operations or DevOps.
* Strong proficiency in Terraform, Kubernetes, and Docker.
* Extensive experience with IAM implementation, GCP Quota management, and Anthos Service Mesh (ASM)/Istio.
* Proven experience with Apigee and the ELK stack.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Jenkins, Spinnaker, and GitHub for automated delivery.
* Proven ability to manage hybrid traffic between cloud and on-premise platforms.
* Strong analytical skills for cost envelope management and capacity planning.
* Advanced proficiency with cloud provider CLIs and automation scripting.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

title: Senior Platform Engineer (AI Focused)
description:
**About EarnIn**

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

As a Senior Platform Engineer (AI Focussed), you will design, build, and operate AI-assisted capabilities within platform-owned infrastructure and developer tooling. You will work across Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, FinOps, and infrastructure-as-code to embed AI directly into the systems that power software delivery — from MCP servers, LLM Gateways, and agentic workflows to automated diagnostics and cost optimization.

You will join the Platform Engineering organization. The team’s mission is to provide reliable, scalable tooling that helps engineers build, test, deploy, and operate software efficiently. In this role, you will split your time between standard platform engineering and AI engineering, with a focus on shipping production-grade AI-assisted workflows inside existing systems. This is a hands-on engineering role. Success is measured by real adoption and measurable improvements in developer efficiency, platform reliability, and operational cost.

This position will be a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and build MCP servers that expose platform capabilities as safe, well-scoped tools for AI agents and developer-facing assistants. Contribute to enterprise MCP patterns, LLM tooling, agentic guardrails, knowledge repositories, and framework rollout.

* Strengthen observability, reliability, and operational excellence: SLOs, error budgets, metrics/traces/logs, and automation that improves MTTD/MTTR.
* Extend the developer control plane with paved paths, scorecards, and self-service actions.
* Instrument platform cost signals — compute, observability, and AI/LLM spend — and build FinOps automation that surfaces waste and supports cost-aware engineering decisions.
* Define success metrics upfront and run time-bound experiments to evaluate impact on developer efficiency, reliability, and cost.
* Document usage guidance, patterns, and best practices to support consistent adoption of proven AI workflows.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering with hands-on experience operating production systems in a cloud environment (AWS preferred).
* Strong coding skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building and operating production services.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), GitOps (Argo CD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and Terraform/Helm/Kustomize for infrastructure automation, service mesh..
* Solid observability skills (Datadog APM/metrics/tracing/logs) with a track record of improving reliability and driving SLO/error-budget culture.
* Hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers — designing tool surfaces, managing scope and auth, and connecting AI agents to real infrastructure.
* Practical experience with structured or agentic AI workflows (e.g., planning/execution separation, human-in-the-loop validation, RAG, tool-use patterns) used in production environments.
* FinOps experience: cloud cost attribution, workload optimization, and AI/LLM spend control.
* Familiarity with LLM gateway/router patterns for cost control, model routing, and observability of AI workloads.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with partner teams in a distributed environment.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. title: Senior SRE  - Data & AI Operations
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior SRE to join our team. As an Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform Production Support Engineer is responsible for ensuring the operational stability, reliability, and availability of enterprise data, analytics, streaming, and integration platforms.
  
  
This role works closely with Platform SRE, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Integration, CloudOps, and Security teams to resolve production issues, coordinate response during incidents, and support ongoing reliability and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Production Support & Operations
  
  

* Monitor platform health across data pipelines, APIs, streaming platforms, and cloud services
* Triage, investigate, and resolve production incidents and service requests
* Execute and improve operational runbooks and standard operating procedures
* Coordinate incident resolution across Platform Engineering, SRE, Data Engineering, and external vendors
* Support release activities, configuration changes, and production validations
* Participate in incident reviews and contribute to problem management activities

Incident, Problem & Change Management
  
  

* Own incident lifecycle activities including detection, communication, resolution, and closure
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to preventive and corrective actions
* Identify recurring issues and work with SRE and engineering teams to reduce operational toil
* Ensure adherence to incident, problem, and change management processes and SLAs

Observability & Monitoring
  
  

* Use monitoring and logging tools to detect anomalies and performance degradation
* Improve alert quality by reducing noise and improving signal-to-noise ratio
* Work with SRE to refine dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics
* Support SLIs/SLOs from an operational execution perspective

GenAI-Driven Support Optimization
  
  

* Leverage GenAI / LLM-based tools to improve production support efficiency and quality
* Use AI-assisted analysis for:

+ Faster log analysis and incident triage
+ Pattern detection across recurring incidents
+ Root cause hypothesis generation

* Contribute to building and maintaining AI-powered support assistants (e.g., Platform GPT) for:

+ Runbook recommendations
+ Knowledge retrieval and troubleshooting guidance
+ Incident summarization and post-incident reporting

* Identify opportunities where GenAI can reduce manual effort in:

+ Incident analysis
+ Knowledge management
+ Support documentation
+ Alert enrichment and contextualization

* Partner with Platform Engineering to operationalize AI-enabled support workflows safely and responsibly

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Act as a key interface between Production Support, SRE, and Platform Engineering

* Maintain clear documentation of incidents, known issues, and operational procedures
* Mentor junior support engineers and promote operational best practices
* Participate in platform readiness and operational reviews

* Hands-on operational experience with:

+ Data platforms and pipelines
+ API platforms (e.g., Apigee, GKE etc.,)
+ Streaming systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub)

* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release processes

* Expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience in infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Terraform

title: Sr. SW Engineer (3 - 5 years of exp in Python, AI & Agentic Automation)
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Corporate Reliability Engineering is advancing an engineering-first model focused on reliability, automation, quality, security, and proactive operations.
**This hands-on I5 role will work directly with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and adjacent engineering and operations teams to design, build, test, deploy, and support secure AI, agentic automation, API, and reliability solutions across enterprise Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database and Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), and Network environments.**
The engineer will convert recurring operational issues into maintainable, auditable, and production-ready solutions that reduce manual effort, accelerate diagnosis and resolution, strengthen service resilience, and deliver measurable operational outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver AI/ML applications, LLM-enabled solutions, RAG, agentic workflows, automation frameworks, APIs, integrations, and reusable engineering components.
* Build intelligent capabilities for incident triage, knowledge retrieval, service-health analysis, root-cause investigation, remediation recommendations, and approved automated execution.
* Automate workflows across Windows, Linux/Unix, Oracle Database/EBS, and Network operations through scripting, orchestration, event-driven patterns, and secure API integrations.
* Integrate with approved enterprise ticketing, monitoring, CMDB, knowledge, database, collaboration, source-control, and deployment platforms
* Engineer for reliability through testing, exception handling, rollback, observability, telemetry, runbooks, support models, operational handoff, and measurable service outcomes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, architecture, operations, and product teams and communicate technical decisions, risks, controls, and outcomes clearly

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Professional Attributes**

* Work as an embedded engineering partner with Core Infrastructure, Oracle Database, Network, Security, and Reliability Engineering teams to understand operational needs and deliver practical, supportable solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with subject matter experts, product owners, operations teams, and global stakeholders; actively listen, incorporate feedback, and align teams around shared outcomes.
* Demonstrate a team-first mindset by sharing knowledge, documenting solutions, mentoring peers, supporting collective problem-solving, and contributing to a respectful and inclusive engineering culture.
* Combine strong technical depth with professionalism, humility, adaptability, accountability, and sound judgment when leading discussions or responding to operational challenges.
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, design choices, and business impacts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Operate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and balance speed, reliability, security, governance, teamwork, and customer impact.

**Visa Governance, Security & Responsible AI Expectations**

* Follow Visa policies, Key Controls, Technical and Design Security Requirements, approved architecture standards, and the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) throughout design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Apply secure coding and participate in code review, security assessment, dependency and open-source review, vulnerability remediation, security testing, and required release approvals before production promotion.
* Protect Visa information according to its classification and approved handling requirements. Use approved platforms and data sources, enforce least-privilege access, protect credentials and secrets, and prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, retention, or transmission.
* Implement traceability through authenticated access, change records, version control, event logging, monitoring, evidence retention, documented ownership, and support procedures.
* Apply Visa AI governance requirements across the lifecycle, including defined ownership, risk assessment, data-use review, validation, ongoing monitoring, documented limitations, escalation paths, and controlled retirement or material change.
* Design human oversight and approval gates appropriate to risk. Automated actions must remain within approved permissions and guardrails, with safe failure handling, rollback, and manual intervention paths.
* Validate generative and agentic AI solutions for quality, reliability, security, privacy, information integrity, and operational risk; document evaluation methods, acceptance criteria, evidence, limitations, and monitoring.
* Escalate security incidents, privacy concerns, control gaps, model risks, unexpected AI behavior, and policy exceptions through approved Visa processes.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, automation engineering, AI/ML engineering, agentic systems, reliability engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Hands-on experience using Claude Code, GitHub, Copilot, Power automate
* Hands-on experience developing maintainable applications, scripts, APIs, integrations, automations, or workflow-based solutions in enterprise IT environments.
* Proficiency in Python and one or more of PowerShell, Bash, or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus experience with Git, testing, debugging, APIs, and CI/CD.
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agent frameworks, tools or function calling, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, technical judgment, ownership, adaptability, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience integrating with ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, monitoring platforms, or enterprise support data.
* Experience in reliability engineering, incident and problem management, root-cause analysis, operational automation, release validation, or controlled deployment.
* Ability to define measurable outcomes such as reduced manual effort, higher automation success, faster analysis, fewer repeat issues, stronger traceability, and improved service reliability.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Monitoring and Anomaly Detection (Monetization)
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
  
  
The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.
  
  
This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.
* Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.
* Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.
* Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.
* Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.
* Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.
* Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.
* Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.
* Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.
* Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.
* Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.
* Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.

**About The Team**
The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. title: Software Engineer II, DevOps
description:
**About Audax**
audax means courage. To have the courage to change the banking scene, eliminating constraints caused by existing legacy infrastructure. Our mission is to empower banks and financial institutions to scale and modernise at speed, reaching new customers without breaking the bank.
  
  
We began our journey supplying services to and powering Standard Chartered’s white-label plug and play Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) solution, Standard Chartered nexus, through our technology capabilities. At audax, we seek go-getters who are hungry for growth and can bring fresh perspectives.
  
  
Website - https://audax.io/
  
  
  
  
**Summary**
The DevX team is looking for a DevOps Engineer to help build and maintain the build platform, reusable CI/CD components and DevSecOps tooling used for software delivery across the organisation. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will read, write, debug and test pipeline logic, shared libraries and automation code in Java/Groovy and TypeScript. It is not a Terraform/Kubernetes-only DevOps position.
  
  
You will work on clearly assigned tasks across CI/CD pipelines, container build workflows and security tooling integrations, with guidance from senior engineers. You will help keep pipelines reliable, support security scanning workflows, and build experience across platform engineering and developer experience practice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver assigned CI/CD pipeline tasks (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions) reliably and within sprint expectations.
* Develop and maintain shared build library components (Groovy/Java) and reusable GitHub Actions workflows (TypeScript/JavaScript) as directed by senior engineers, with appropriate tests for owned changes.
* Support base image build and promotion (ECR, GHCR), release branch workflows, package publishing and build promotion for assigned services, in line with the release calendar.
* Implement assigned security tooling integrations (SAST/SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, SBOM generation) following established configurations, and assist with image signing (Cosign) and admission policy (Kyverno) tasks under senior guidance.
* Contribute to integrations with the vulnerability management and application metadata platforms (APIs, quality gates, pipeline checks) on assigned tasks.
* Troubleshoot assigned build failures and pipeline issues, escalating complex or cross-team blockers early.
* Contribute to upkeep of build/CI monitoring and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or equivalent), the integration-test platform and developer-facing test automation workflows.
* Maintain build specifications and repository onboarding configurations for new or migrated services, using scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy, TypeScript) to automate assigned build and pipeline tasks.
* Handle BAU support requests from product squads through agreed support routes (unblock builds, clarify pipeline behaviour) and escalate infrastructure issues early.
* Write and maintain runbooks and developer-facing documentation for owned changes, and take part in team routines (stand-ups, reviews, pairing), raising clarifications and dependencies early to avoid rework.

**Requirements**

* Strong, demonstrable proficiency in Java/Groovy and TypeScript, including reading, debugging, extending and testing production pipeline and platform code. Terraform/Kubernetes knowledge alone is not sufficient.
* Working proficiency in Gradle-based builds and unit testing (Spock/JUnit for Groovy/Java; Jest or equivalent for TypeScript).
* Hands-on experience maintaining Jenkins shared libraries and/or GitHub Actions reusable workflows, beyond writing YAML or Terraform modules.
* Experience in DevOps, platform engineering or a related discipline, with practical CI/CD exposure and working knowledge of Git workflows (branching, PR flows, release tagging) and GitHub CLI.
* Experience with Docker container builds and registries (ECR, GHCR or similar), and basic AWS knowledge (ECR, IAM, networking fundamentals).
* Scripting proficiency in Python and/or Bash, alongside Groovy and TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes fundamentals (CKAD preferred), with exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Ansible) and GitOps patterns (Argo CD, Helm or equivalent) for troubleshooting build-to-deploy issues.
* Familiarity with integrating security scanning tools (SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning, SBOM) into CI/CD, and exposure to dependency update and static-analysis tooling (e.g. Renovate, Semgrep, MegaLinter).
* Ability to work with REST APIs and metadata/registry services that back CI quality gates and ownership routing.
* Comfort supporting Java/Spring Boot and Node/TypeScript build pipelines, with willingness to handle recurring BAU support alongside feature delivery.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be Part of a Bold Vision – At audax, we’re not just building software – we’re transforming how financial institutions and businesses manage risk, compliance, and growth. Join a team that’s fearless in challenging the status quo.
* Flexible, People-First Workplace – We value the importance of Family, Team, Self. In that order.
* Competitive Rewards and Startup Perks – We offer competitive salaries and meaningful benefits that look after your well-being.

**Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood audax’s Privacy Policy for Employees, Freelancers, Contractors and Job Applicants (the “Policy”), and consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data by audax for the purposes set out in the Policy.
  
  
You may withdraw consent for such collection, use and disclosure, and make an access or correction request in respect of your personal data, in accordance with the Policy by emailing dpo@audax.io.
  
  
**Disclaimer:**
At Audax, we use AI to support our recruitment process, including reviewing applications and identifying candidates whose skills and experience best match our opportunities. AI assists our recruiters—it does not make hiring decisions. All applications are reviewed by our recruitment team, and hiring decisions are made by people. Please ensure the information you submit is accurate and reflects your own qualifications and experience.

title: Sr. DevOps Network Engineer | India
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
  
  
Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
  
  
Five9 is a leading provider of cloud software for the enterprise contact center market, bringing the power of the cloud to thousands of customers and facilitating more than three billion customer interactions annually. Since 2001, Five9 has led the cloud revolution in contact centers, helping organizations transition from legacy premise-based solutions to the cloud. Five9 provides businesses with cloud contact center software that is reliable, secure, compliant and scalable, which is designed to create exceptional customer experiences, increase agent productivity and deliver tangible business results.
  
  
**Role Overview**
To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
* Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
* Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
* Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
* Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
* Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
* Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
* Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
* Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
* Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
* Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
* Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
* Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
* Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
* Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
* Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
* Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
* CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
* Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
* Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
* Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
* Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

**Diversity & Inclusion**
Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
Workplace location: This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Bengaluru)
description:
**We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru**

**About ReN3**

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment.

**About the Role**

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, security and cost of a multi-tenant AI platform running on Kubernetes. You’ll own the full spectrum of reliability engineering, from provisioning infrastructure with Terraform to building alerting systems that keep our services running smoothly. As one of the first SREs on the team, you’ll have the opportunity to shape our engineering practices, establish standards, and build a strong foundation for reliability as we scale.

**Our stack**

* **Platform:**
  GKE, Terraform, Helm charts deployed through GitOps (Argo CD)
* **Services:**
  TypeScript (NestJS) APIs and workers, Python agent runtime, JVM data-processing jobs
* **Data and messaging:**
  PostgreSQL (plus MySQL and SQL Server for some customer deployments), Kafka, Temporal, Redis, a vector store
* **Security:**
  OpenFGA for fine-grained permissions, a secrets manager, sandboxed code execution (gVisor)
* **Observability:**
  OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs
* **AI:**
  several LLM providers behind a gateway, plus self-hosted models

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own SLOs.**
  Define and defend uptime and latency targets for the APIs, the document-ingestion pipeline and the agent runtime.
* **Change infrastructure only through code.**
  Every change goes through Terraform and GitOps: planned, reviewed and applied. No click-ops and no ad-hoc kubectl in production.
* **Make the system observable.**
  Build tracing, dashboards and alerts that point to the cause, not just the symptom. Add AI-specific signals: token spend, provider latency and errors, queue depth and workflow backlog.
* **Lead incidents.**
  Run on-call, lead response, write blameless postmortems and make sure the root cause gets fixed.
* **Control capacity and cost.**
  Autoscaling, Kafka and Temporal throughput, database sizing, and LLM and GPU spend.
* **Keep tenants isolated and secure.**
  Secrets handling, network policy, sandbox isolation and least-privilege access. Help us pass customer security reviews and compliance audits.
* **Support customer deployments.**
  Some customers need their own region, their own cloud or their own data centre. Help make those installs repeatable.
* **Run operations with agents, safely.**
  Use coding agents to write Terraform, runbooks, scripts and alert triage. Build the guardrails (plan review, dry runs, scoped credentials, human approval) that keep agents from making unsafe changes to production.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Based in Bengaluru
* **3–5 years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering**
  , running production Kubernetes for real users.
* **Strong Terraform and Kubernetes skills**
  on at least one major cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine).
* **You write real code**
  in Python, Go or TypeScript: tools and automation, not only YAML.
* **Daily use of agentic coding**
  , including on infrastructure. You can explain how you use agents without risking production.
* **Hands-on incident experience**
  with databases, queues, networking or DNS. You have been the one who found the cause.
* **Observability experience**
  with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog or similar.
* **High agency**
  . Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes.

**Nice-to-have**

* Running Kafka or Temporal in production.
* PostgreSQL operations: tuning, backups and point-in-time recovery, upgrades.
* Multi-tenant SaaS for enterprise or regulated customers.
* OpenShift, on-premises or air-gapped deployments.
* Serving LLMs or running GPU workloads.
* Sandboxing technologies such as gVisor or Firecracker.

**How to apply**

* Submit your resume (more specifications below).
* Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL, a writeup or a 3-minute Loom).

1. Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on a production incident you led: what broke, how you found it and what you changed afterwards.

title: Senior Production Engineer
description:
**About DataNimbus**

DataNimbus is an enterprise AI company with deep vertical solutions in financial services

and industrial sectors. We build domain-native AI that understands how industries actually

operate — not just how data flows through them. Our solutions are outcome-driven and

industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets

perform, and how businesses grow. We go deep so our customers don't have to start from

scratch.

**Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes.**

**About the Role**

When a bank's payment doesn't move, someone has to find out why — in code they didn't

write, on servers they can't log into, with the bank on the line. We're hiring two people who

want to be that someone.

Our payments platform moves money for large banks: microservices in Node.js, Go, Java

and Angular on MongoDB, NATS and Redis, running on Kubernetes.

When a payment doesn't move, a fee doesn't post or a screen goes blank, you find out why

from the code, the data and the logs. Then you fix it so it can't happen again.

**What You'll Do**

● Every production issue, end to end: from the bank's ticket to the fix running in their

release.

● Hunt root causes. Triage bank tickets, reproduce the failure, find the cause in code,

data and logs. When it's infra, network or a third party, prove it with evidence.

● Read the data like a detective. Read-only MongoDB queries that show exactly what

happened. Audit live data (schedules, holidays, duplicates) before it hurts, and

reconcile it safely.

● Make it fast. Slow screens, long-running queries, connection-pool leaks, end-of-day

CPU spikes, pod evictions: take each to a cause, then fix the query, the index or the

resource limit.

● Ship the fix. Backport it across many live release lines, knowing its blast radius

before it goes out.

● Pass the bank's scrutiny. Triage vulnerability-scan findings and answer audit

questionnaires.

● Be the voice the bank trusts. Customer replies, RCAs, audit responses, weekly status

reports, leadership briefings.

● Write it all down. Runbooks, RCAs, decisions and the things only you know go into

shared docs the whole team can find.

● Build your own tools. scripts, agents and knowledge bases that make the next

investigation faster than the last.

**What We're Looking For**

● 5+ years owning production for distributed systems, as an SRE, production or

backend engineer.

● Fearless with code you didn't write. Node.js and Go fluently, Java well enough. You

can trace an issue from an Angular screen down to the database.

● MongoDB in depth. Aggregation pipelines, $lookup, indexes, explain(), slow-query

logs and schema drift. Safe, read-only queries on production data.

● Distributed-systems instincts. Event-driven flows (NATS), Redis, schedulers,

workflow engines, webhooks, retries, idempotency and race conditions.

● Containers. Docker, Kubernetes (limits, evictions, OOMKilled), Jenkins and AWS.

Comfortable diagnosing systems you can only see through logs you asked for.

● Excellent written and verbal communication. Short, accurate RCAs and replies that

bank engineers and executives act on. Calm and clear on an incident call, and able to

explain a failure to an executive in two minutes.

● A documenting habit. You leave runbooks, decision records and how-tos behind you,

so nobody has to ask you twice.

● You have looked at how your team works, found a better way and made it stick —

and you can tell us what changed.

● AI-native. Python, Node.js and mongosh for audits, safe data fixes and tooling. Daily

use of AI coding agents (we use Claude Code).

**Why Join DataNimbus?**

At DataNimbus, we believe in shaping a sustainable, AI-driven future while offering an

environment that prioritises learning, innovation, and growth. Our core values —

Customer-Centricity, Simplicity, Curiosity, Responsibility, and Adaptability — are the

foundation of our workplace, ensuring every team member can make a meaningful impact.

Joining DataNimbus means:

● Working with cutting-edge technologies at the intersection of Data and AI.

● Contributing to solutions trusted by global financial institutions for their scalability,

security, and efficiency.

● Growing in a culture that rewards technical depth, ownership, and continuous learning.

If you're a technical leader who's energised by delivery, not just direction — DataNimbus is the

place for you.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.
* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.
* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.
* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.
* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.
* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.
* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.
* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.
* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.
* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).
* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.
* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.

* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.
* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).
