description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.
  
  
Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.
  
  
**Role Overview**
To complement our rapid growth, we are actively sourcing for a Network Engineer to operate in a 24/7 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment maintaining IP Networking components in a production setting.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, engineer, and oversee highly scalable CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, digital-twin dry-running, and zero-downtime deployment of configurations across massive physical and virtual network fabrics
* Champion the "Network-as-Code" paradigm, establishing enterprise-wide GitOps workflows and enforcing source control (Git) as the absolute single source of truth for all network state, policy, and infrastructure design
* Drive the strategic vision for network automation, designing complex, reusable code frameworks and Playbooks to permanently eliminate manual configuration and operational "toil" at a global scale
* Design and optimize massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and container networking interfaces (CNIs) supporting ultra-high-throughput, multi-region cloud and bare-metal environments
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority (SME / Tier 4) for complex network, routing, and overlay issues, rapidly deciphering and resolving the most difficult challenges across physical underlays and software-defined layers
* Design and implement next-generation telemetry, monitoring, and alerting-as-code platforms, leveraging advanced heuristics for proactive auto-remediation of performance, security, and capacity issues

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner at a strategic level with Enterprise Designers, SRE leaders, and Platform teams to build and implement highly resilient, secure, and multi-tenant-isolated network infrastructure
* Establish coding standards and write/review sophisticated Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Python, and Bash
* Lead the engineering, deployment, and optimization of modern overlay and container networking solutions, particularly VXLAN, OVN (Open Virtual Network), and Project Calico
* Design the automation of complex security and traffic management policies across enterprise-grade firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet) and load balancers (F5 BIG-IP/Cloudflare/Octavia)
* Embed "Security-as-Code" directly into CI/CD pipelines, engineering automated validation gates for security groups, ACLs, and firewall rules prior to production pushes
* Engineer robust, automated network validation suites to continuously verify network health, state, and complex routing tables (BGP, OSPF) pre- and post-deployment
* Drive the adoption of code-based infrastructure definitions and dynamic, living technical documentation (e.g., NetBox, Git Markdown), setting the standard for documentation across the engineering organization

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in Network Engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with a deeply established focus on large-scale network design, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
* Expert-level proficiency in engineering complex network automation tooling utilizing Ansible, Terraform, and Python (including deep experience with network-specific libraries like Netmiko, Nornir, or NAPALM)
* Deep design and operational expertise with massive-scale software-defined networks (SDN) and overlays, specifically VXLAN, OVN, and Project Calico
* Advanced mastery of Kubernetes networking designs (CNIs, Ingress controllers, Service Mesh, Kube-Proxy behaviors) at an enterprise scale
* Extensive, expert-level experience engineering and automating enterprise edge, routing, and security fabrics, including Cisco Nexus (9k/7k/5k/2k), Arista, Versa SD-WAN, and firewalls (Palo Alto and Fortinet)
* Authoritative knowledge of API-driven application delivery and load balancing across monolithic and cloud-native stacks (e.g., F5 BIG-IP AS3, Cloudflare APIs, Octavia LBaaS)
* Deep Linux internals and networking expertise, including advanced knowledge of Linux network namespaces, virtual interfaces, eBPF/iptables, and kernel-level routing
* CCIE-level (or equivalent) mastery of core routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, EVPN) and a comprehensive understanding of how virtual/container overlay networks map to physical underlays
* Extensive experience designing and scaling CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and implementing test-driven development (TDD) for infrastructure changes
* Unparalleled troubleshooting capabilities utilizing advanced packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), NetFlow, and log aggregation platforms to trace asymmetric routing and microburst traffic across hybrid fabrics
* Proven track record of technical leadership, including mentoring mid-level engineers, leading design review boards, and driving cross-functional engineering initiatives
* Deep telecommunications background, specifically VoIP, RTP, SIP peering/trunking, and Session Border Controllers (SBC), is highly advantageous
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders while fostering a collaborative, DevOps-oriented engineering culture

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
  
  
Cognite operates at the forefront of
**industrial digitalization, building AI**
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
  
  
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE)**
to join our Cloud deployment team and take ownership of the reliability, scalability, automation, and operational excellence of our core database infrastructure.
  
  
You will work across
**PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka**
, supporting a multi-cloud, Kubernetes-based platform at significant scale. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure and database challenges, eliminating operational toil, and building highly automated systems.
  
  
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and Product teams to ensure our data platforms are highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Managed PostgreSQL Fleet Orchestration**

* Standardize and automate the lifecycle management of a fleet of 1000+ PostgreSQL instances across Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks.
* Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, backups, and operational workflows.
* Improve consistency and reliability across our PostgreSQL fleet while reducing manual operational effort.
* Work with cloud-managed PostgreSQL services including Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server, Amazon RDS, and GCP Cloud SQL.
* Evolve our provisioning and configuration approach using Kubernetes-based and Terraform-driven workflows.

**Hybrid Elasticsearch Operations**

* Design, operate, and scale high-performance Elasticsearch clusters across Elastic Cloud (SaaS) and ECK (self-managed Kubernetes) environments.
* Own the reliability and performance of Elasticsearch infrastructure supporting search, semantic retrieval, vector workloads, and high-volume operational data.
* Establish best practices around cluster sizing, capacity planning, shard management, upgrades, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Support Elasticsearch deployments where PostgreSQL is the source of truth as well as environments where Elasticsearch is the authoritative datastore.
* Build automation to simplify provisioning and lifecycle management across Elastic Cloud and ECK.
* Help improve security, connectivity, zone awareness, and operational resilience across multi-cloud deployments.

**Kafka Streaming Infrastructure**

* Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of Kafka clusters supporting high-throughput, low-latency event streaming across the platform.
* Operate Kafka in both self-managed (Kubernetes-based, e.g. Strimzi/Kafka Operator) and managed (e.g. Confluent Cloud, MSK) configurations across multi-cloud environments.
* Drive capacity planning, partition and topic design, replication strategy, and broker-level performance tuning.
* Establish and automate best practices around upgrades, rolling restarts, backups/disaster recovery, and schema evolution (e.g. Schema Registry).
* Build monitoring and alerting for consumer lag, broker health, ISR status, and throughput to enable early incident detection.
* Partner with Software Engineering to ensure producer/consumer patterns, retention policies, and topic ownership scale cleanly as usage grows.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of experience in Database Reliability Engineering, Database Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, or a closely related role.
* Strong hands-on experience operating PostgreSQL at scale, preferably in cloud-managed environments.
* Strong experience with Elasticsearch, including cluster administration, performance tuning, scaling, shard management, and troubleshooting.
* Experience operating databases and stateful workloads on Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kafka or another distributed database/storage system is highly valuable.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar tools.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform — Azure, AWS, or GCP — with exposure to multi-cloud environments preferred.
* Strong understanding of database reliability principles including high availability, disaster recovery, backups, replication, capacity planning, and observability.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming using Python, Go, or a similar language.
* Experience automating repetitive operational tasks and building self-service infrastructure.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-management skills, with the ability to diagnose complex distributed-system failures.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Kafka and fdb-kubernetes-operator.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud and ECK.

**Proficiency in Go for building automation, tooling, or operators; Python or another scripting language is a plus.**

* Experience managing PostgreSQL through Kubernetes operators or custom resources.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and building automation for stateful workloads.
* Experience operating databases across multi-cloud and private-cloud environments.
* Experience with observability platforms and database performance monitoring.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, data replication, consistency, and failure-domain design.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Database provisioning and lifecycle operations become highly automated and repeatable.
* Operational toil across PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Kafka is significantly reduced.
* Database platforms can scale reliably with business and customer growth.
* Incidents are detected early and resolved through strong automation and observability.
* Database infrastructure is consistent and resilient across Azure, AWS, GCP, and private-cloud environments.
* Engineering teams can consume reliable database infrastructure without requiring significant manual DBRE intervention.

**Why This Role?**
This is an opportunity to work on
**large-scale, distributed data infrastructure**
at the heart of a modern Knowledge Graph platform. You will have significant ownership across three critical database technologies and will play a key role in making our data infrastructure more automated, reliable, and scalable.
  
  
**Learn More About Us**

* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

title: Principal Engineer
description:
The Principal Engineer is the most senior individual contributor in the System Platform Team. This is not an architect-in-an-ivory-tower role - it is a hands-on technical leadership position where roughly 60% of time is spent writing production code and 40% on cross-cutting technical responsibilities: architecture, technology evaluation, design reviews, and mentoring. The expectation is that when the team runs into its hardest technical problem, the Principal is the one who unblocks it - not by delegating, but by pairing or by writing the solution.
  
  
Over the course of the year, the Principal intentionally rotates across different engineering domains - developer experience, release engineering, data and messaging, incident and compliance tooling. This breadth is deliberate: by the end of the year, the Principal has deep firsthand knowledge of the full platform codebase, which is what makes their architecture reviews, technology decisions, and mentorship credible across all areas.
  
  
**The Stack You Will Work On**

* A Java/Spring Boot microservices platform (GreyMatter) running on GKE, backed by Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO/S3
* An Erlang/OTP real-time robot-control system (Butler Core) running on GCP VMs, using Mnesia, EMQX (MQTT broker), and Cowboy HTTP
* A hybrid CI/CD setup spanning GitHub (mono-repo for 19 platform services) and Bitbucket (legacy/firmware repositories), with Jenkins, Spinnaker, ArgoCD, Nexus, Terraform, and Ansible
* Kafka-based event streaming with Avro schema contracts and Redis for payload management
* An internal context-retrieval server that surfaces runbooks, tickets, deployment history, and architecture docs as LLM-queryable tools
* An incident management platform (evaluating commercial tools vs. in-house) with a custom compliance evidence layer for SOC2/ISO audits
* A home-grown Just-In-Time access portal covering GKE, GCP IAM, Kafka ACLs, SQL, Mnesia, and config management, integrated with Google Workspace SSO.

**Responsibilites**
**Architecture & Technical Direction**

* Lead cross-team architecture reviews - help the team make large technical decisions, document trade-offs, and land on durable solutions
* Own build-vs-buy decisions: evaluate commercial tools against in-house alternatives with documented analysis, and live with the consequences
* Define and enforce engineering standards across the whole team: schema conventions, observability patterns, security postures, secrets hygiene, API design
* Review system designs across every engineering area the team works in - not just the area you are currently contributing to
* Partner with the Associate Director on technical hiring: contribute to interview design, loop calibration, and leveling decisions

**Hands-On Engineering**

* Rotate across different engineering domains throughout the year, contributing meaningfully to each - shipping production code, not just reviewing it
* Write and maintain design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) - these are required deliverables, not optional write-ups
* Unblock engineers on hard problems by pairing directly, not by delegating to someone else
* Build and own cross-cutting libraries, shared tooling, and foundational components that multiple services depend on
* Mentorship & Culture
* Technically mentor the Staff Engineers - paired design sessions, deep code review, escalation target for hard problems
* Raise the bar in code review: model the level of feedback and depth of analysis that sets the team standard
* Drive a blameless engineering culture - incidents and mistakes are learning opportunities, not blame events
* Treat documentation as first-class engineering output: design docs and runbooks ship with features, not after them

**Requirements**

* 14+ years of software engineering with at least 5 years at Staff Engineer level or equivalent senior IC level
* Has shipped at least one platform, developer-experience, or infrastructure product at scale that other engineering teams measurably adopted - not just delivered, but adopted and continued to use
* Production experience across at least four of: Kafka, Kubernetes, GitOps and ArgoCD, Grafana/InfluxDB observability stacks, OAuth2/OIDC identity systems, LLM orchestration or RAG systems
* Demonstrated build-vs-buy judgment: has made significant make-or-buy decisions, documented the trade-offs, and lived with the outcome
* Deep system design instincts - can hold a 10+ service distributed system in mind and identify coupling problems and failure modes before they become production incidents
* Excellent written communication - drives technical influence through documents, not just verbal authority in meetings
* Comfortable operating as the senior-most IC on a small team where pragmatism and real constraints shape decisions

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with Erlang/OTP, Mnesia, or BEAM VM tooling - for context on the Butler Core platformExperience with hybrid deployment environments spanning Kubernetes and traditional VMs in the same production system
* Has led a technical governance body - architecture review board, RFC process, or equivalent cross-team decision-making forum
* Background evaluating and procuring engineering tooling at a technical (not just commercial) level
* Familiarity with VDA5050 or AGV/robotics communication protocols

title: Observability Engineer (Datadog) III
description:
**The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with**
**Standard India**
A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture, focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Observability Engineer (Datadog) plays a central role in consolidating a fragmented monitoring estate onto Datadog as our single observability platform and migrating application performance monitoring off AppDynamics. This role does the engineering that makes that real: instrumenting services, standing up integrations, and building the monitors, dashboards, and service level objectives that teams actually use during an incident.
  
  
The work has two phases and you will do both: migration, moving instrumentation and coverage onto Datadog service by service and retiring what it replaces; and platform operations, running Datadog well, keeping the signal clean, controlling what we ingest, and enabling other teams to self-serve. Our outcome measure is business impact minutes: everything this team builds is judged on whether it helps us detect a problem before a customer does and diagnose it faster once we are on the call. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a monitoring or command center role.
  
  

* Ability to work on‑site in Bengaluru, India is a requirement of the role. \*

**Mode of Working:**
This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on‑site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate the Datadog agent across a heterogeneous estate spanning Linux, Windows, virtual machines, and Azure Kubernetes Service, using repeatable, automated deployment patterns rather than manual configuration.
* Build and maintain integrations across cloud services, databases, middleware, messaging, and job scheduling, including custom and API-based collectors, and migrate APM instrumentation from AppDynamics to Datadog service by service, validating parity before decommissioning the source.
* Build monitors, dashboards, and service level objectives that are usable under pressure, with error budgets defined alongside them, and continuously improve signal quality by tuning, consolidating, and retiring alerts so that every alert is actionable and attributable to an owner.
* Maintain the ServiceNow integration that turns monitor events into incidents, including priority mapping, deduplication, and closure behavior, and automate the platform by managing monitors, dashboards, and configuration as code through Terraform and the Datadog API.
* Watch what we ingest by understanding the cost consequence of log volume, indexed spans, and custom metric cardinality, and enable other teams by writing the documentation and standards that let application teams instrument their own services correctly.

**Education**
**Skills and Background You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field is required.

**Experience**

* Roughly 3 to 6 years in observability, site reliability, infrastructure, or platform engineering.
* Hands-on Datadog experience in production — agent deployment at scale across mixed operating systems, custom and API-based integrations where no native one exists, APM instrumentation owned through a migration, and monitors and dashboards managed as code rather than clicked together in the UI. You should be able to explain a rollout you personally worked on and the decisions inside it.
* Applied competence in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Linux — comfortable in a containerized environment and able to reason about how instrumentation behaves inside it, including agent deployment as a DaemonSet, autodiscovery, and pod and container tagging. Scripting and automation in Python or equivalent.
* Judgment on telemetry cost and cardinality — able to reason about the cost consequence of log volume, indexed spans, and custom metric cardinality, and to catch an unbounded tag or a chatty metric before it reaches the invoice.
* Troubleshooting instinct: you can tell the difference between a broken service and broken instrumentation, and you check the second before escalating the first.
* Clear written communication in English, including documentation another engineer can follow without you in the room.
* Services migrated off AppDynamics onto Datadog APM with validated parity, on the agreed sequence.
* Alert signal-to-noise measurably improved, with retired alerts documented rather than silently disabled.
* Proactive detection rising: more incidents found by a monitor than by a user.
* Platform configuration managed as code, reviewable, and reproducible.
* Application teams instrumenting their own services against your standards.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience migrating from AppDynamics, Dynatrace, New Relic, or a similar platform onto Datadog.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform, a directional goal for how we manage the platform.
* OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
* ServiceNow ITSM integration work in a production incident context.
* Experience in a large, regulated enterprise estate or a global capability center operating model.

**Desirable Certifications**

* Datadog Certifications (Observability, APM, Logs)
* SRE Foundation (DevOps Institute) or equivalent SRE fundamentals credential
* One cloud fundamentals certification (AZ‑900 preferred)

**Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate**

* Adaptability: Adjusts quickly to evolving priorities and incident situations; remains calm, analytical, and collaborative under pressure.
* Independence: Takes ownership of decisions and technical troubleshooting, proactively identifying reliability risks before they become incidents.
* Willingness to Learn: Continuously grows technical competence in reliability engineering, automation, incident response, observability, and cloud‑native practices.

**Why Join**
**Standard India?**
We Have Built An Enduring Legacy Of Stability, Financial Strength And Exceptional Customer Service Through The Contributions Of The Service-oriented People Who Choose To Work At The Standard. To Ensure We Can Attract And Retain The Best Talent, When You Join StanCorp Global Servicesyou Can Expect
  
  

* A rich benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial goals
* An annual incentive bonus plan tied to both individual and organizational performance
* Paid time off including earned leave, sick/casual leave, and public holidays, in accordance with the company’s leave policy
* A supportive, responsive management approach that empowers you to grow
* Opportunities for career advancement through learning, coaching, and leadership enablement
* A culture where your voice matters - your ideas shape our future, and we win as one
* Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for our customers, communities, and each other

In addition to a competitive salary, our employee-focused benefits are designed to support work-life balance, personal growth, and long-term impact.
  
  
Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.
  
  
StanCorp Global Services India Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, caste, HIV status or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws of India.

access, port forwarding and SSO-based short-lived credentials — replacing shared keys and ad-hoc access.Implement least-privilege IAM roles and policies, with access that is auditable and easy to grant or revoke.Provide self-serve tooling and documentation so developers can spin up, debug and access environments without waiting on DevOps.Reliability, observability and securitySet up monitoring, logging and alerting (e.g. CloudWatch and/or Prometheus/Grafana) with clear dashboards for application and database health.Participate in production incident response, lead root-cause patching, network segmentation, security groups, encryption at rest and in transit, and secret management.CollaborationWork closely with backend, frontend and QA engineers and the product support team to remove infrastructure bottlenecks.Document architecture, runbooks and standards, and share DevOps best practices across the team.Impact and OpportunitiesYour work will directly shape how reliably and quickly Recruiterflow reaches thousands of recruiters every day. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins also fine) and Git-based workflows.Infrastructure as Code: hands-on with Terraform, CloudFormation or AWS CDK.Linux administration: strong Ubuntu/Linux skills, including networking, SSH, Nginx/web servers and process management.Scripting: solid Bash and Python skills for automation and tooling.Security: practical experience with IAM least-privilege design, secret management and secure access patterns for servers and databases.Observability: experience setting up monitoring, logging and alerting, and handling on-call incidents.Strong problem-solving, clear communication and comfort working as the owner of a function.Preferred QualificationsExperience running Python/Flask (or Django) applications in production, including WSGI servers such as Gunicorn/uWSGI and background workers.Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures and their isolation, scaling and data-safety concerns.Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (ECS, EKS or Kubernetes).Experience with caching and queueing systems such as Redis, Celery, SQS or RabbitMQ.Exposure to zero-trust/secure access tools (AWS SSM, Tailscale, Teleport, AWS IAM Identity Center).Familiarity with supporting AI/LLM workloads on AWS (e.g. Amazon Bedrock).AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, SysOps Administrator or DevOps Engineer Professional).Experience with SFTP/EFS-based file integrations and data migration infrastructure.Join Recruiterflow and own the infrastructure that powers recruitment for thousands of agencies worldwide!

title: MS-AI4AI-PlatformEngineering-SeniorConsultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Engineering Senior Consultant
  
  
**Role Overview:**
EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an
**AI Platform Engineering Senior Consultant**
to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own platform deployment for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* Architect for scale and resilience — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* Partner cross-functionally with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* Manage model-hosting strategy, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* Drive security, compliance, and governance of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* Optimize infrastructure cost and performance, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

**Experience**
**What We're Looking For**

* 3-5 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to work with engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment — building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones.

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

This role is focused on platform engineering and DevOps enablement for the Lean Non-Prod platform, with a strong emphasis on CI/CD pipeline creation, maintenance, and standardization. The candidate should be comfortable working hands-on with GitLab pipelines and related CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins and ArgoCD.
  
  
The person in this role will help build and maintain “golden pipeline” patterns that engineering teams can reuse across different technology stacks. Current and expected pipeline types include Terraform IaC, Maven, Node, ArgoCD, and Liquibase. A near-term focus is getting a reliable Liquibase pipeline operational, including support for Oracle and PostgreSQL database deployment patterns.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Expectations**

* The candidate should have practical experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, especially in GitLab CI. Jenkins and ArgoCD experience are also important. They should understand how to build reusable, governed pipeline templates rather than one-off scripts.
* They should be comfortable working in AWS environments, especially with EKS and Kubernetes-based workloads. We also expect future work to help set up or support the EKS environment in production.
* Infrastructure as Code experience is important, especially Terraform. The candidate should understand how IaC fits into enterprise DevOps, environment promotion, approvals, and governance.
* Security awareness is critical. Regardless of where pipelines or platform components are deployed, the candidate must understand that enterprise controls still apply, including firewall rules, dedicated ERSA/IAM roles, least-privilege access, and management of highly privileged automation paths.
* Liquibase experience would be a strong plus, particularly using Liquibase in CI/CD workflows for Oracle and PostgreSQL. This is one of the more immediate needs.
* Kubernetes, runners, and pipeline execution experience are also valuable. The candidate should ideally understand GitLab runner configuration, troubleshooting, scaling, and secure execution patterns.
* The role requires collaboration with development, QA, security, operations, and platform teams. The person should be able to work through dependencies, clarify requirements, troubleshoot pipeline failures, and document reusable patterns.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* A strong candidate will have 3–5 years of platform engineering, DevOps, or SRE experience with hands-on CI/CD delivery. They should be comfortable with GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Terraform, Kubernetes/EKS, scripting with Bash or Python, and cloud infrastructure in AWS. Experience with Liquibase, Oracle, PostgreSQL, reusable pipeline frameworks, and enterprise security controls would make them especially relevant.

description:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and transparency.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Role Description:**
This is a great opportunity for a hands-on DevOps Engineers or Infrastructure Cloud Engineers with experience in cloud platforms (GCP). You will be tasked with transforming business requirements into robust cloud infrastructure solutions which forms the underlying foundation for all distributed systems and applications of the LSE Group.
  
  
As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various teams to drive cloud adoption and implement GCP standard methodologies.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**
GCP Infrastructure Design and Implementation:
  
  

* Implement scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure using GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, and Interconnect.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and YAML configuration files.

Security and Compliance
  
  

* Apply GCP security best practices including IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, and Organization Policies.

Automation and DevOps Integration
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab pipelines.
* Automate deployments and infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and GitOps practices.

Networking and Hybrid Connectivity
  
  

* Manage VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules and policies, Cloud NAT, and Private Google Access.
* Implement networking features such as VPC Peering, Shared VPC, VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.

Agile Practices and Teamwork Tools
  
  

* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).
* Use Jira for task tracking and Confluence for documentation and teamwork.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Stay current with GCP innovations and evaluate new services for potential adoption.
* Propose and implement improvements to enhance performance, security, and developer experience.

**Required Skills:**
**Experience**

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with GCP services.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Interconnect, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Workload Identity Federation (WIF).
* Experience with Terraform and YAML for Infrastructure as Code.
* Networking knowledge: VPC design, VPN, Cloud NAT, Interconnect, Peering, firewall rules and policies.
* Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (GKE).
* Experience with Python for various applications.
* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

Certifications
  
  

* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or other relevant GCP certifications.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Communication and collaboration abilities.
* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.

title: Senior Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**About Us**

At Tally, we’re driven by one core mission - making business simpler for everyone. As a pioneer in business management software, we’ve been the trusted partner of choice for ~3 million and 7.5 million users across 100+ countries - many of them are MSMEs that form the backbone of global economies.

Our journey is rooted in innovation, guided by deep empathy for customers, and driven by a commitment to excellence. With a legacy of trust and a future fueled by technology, we are shaping the way businesses manage accounting, inventory, compliance, and much more.

We believe in honouring our people, nurturing potential, creating fearlessly, and mastering our craft - all while staying true to our values. If you are looking to make a real impact, grow with purpose, and be part of something meaningful, you’ll find your place at Tally.

As we continue to grow, we are working towards a larger ambition - to become the technology backbone for global economic progress.

**About Cloud Operations**

Cloud Operations mission is to deliver the best-in-class connected services in public clouds for Tally’s customers by ensuring unmatched reliability, strong security realized at the most optimal cost. Engineers here get to design, implement, and operationalize solutions leveraging deep cloud native technologies that ultimately deliver a flawless experience for our customers.

**Role:**
Senior Cloud Operations Engineer/Associate Staff Engineer

**Experience:**
7 - 12 years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**What You Will Own**

In this role, you will own the reliability, scalability, and security of Tally's cloud infrastructure end-to-end, driving architectural decisions that shape the evolution of the platform. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to lead major infrastructure initiatives, provide technical direction, and mentor engineers through complex, business-critical deployments. You will also champion an automation-first approach and establish strong observability practices across the platform, proactively identifying systemic risks, preventing incidents, and driving permanent root-cause solutions instead of temporary fixes.

**Where your Expertise Meets Our Future**

Deep, hands-on expertise architecting, configuring, and troubleshooting large-scale, production-grade services in OCI / AWS cloud environments, with a track record of resolving complex, ambiguous issues under pressure.

Proven experience owning the full lifecycle of application deployment and management in OCI / AWS cloud, including capacity planning, performance optimization, cost governance, and driving reliability at scale.

AWS and OCI cloud operations are central to this role — candidates with strong, demonstrable depth in either platform are encouraged to apply; you'llbe expected to quickly build cross-platform proficiency and bring senior-level judgment to design and operational trade-offs across both environments.

Strong track record of designing, deploying, and running production Kubernetes clusters at scale using OCI OKE and/or AWS EKS, including cluster architecture decisions, workload management, upgrade strategy, and cluster health monitoring.

Proven ability to lead rapid, high-pressure troubleshooting of complex, multi-layered infrastructure, OS, and application issues ,acting as an escalation point and driving incidents through root cause analysis(RCA) to full service restoration.

Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, mentor junior engineers, and represent the cloud operations function in cross-functional and leadership discussions.

**Intermediate Skills Required**

Advanced expertise in configuring, hardening, and maintaining Linux hosts at scale, with strong shell scripting skills to build reusable operational tooling.

Deep, hands-on expertise with container technology such as Docker, and strong command of the OCI OKE and AWS EKS ecosystems, including designing for scale and resilience.

Strong command of network security architecture, including firewall rule management, network segmentation, zero-trust principles, and cloud security groups/NACLs, with the judgment to make and defend design trade-offs.

Strong grounding in CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps principles, with experience improving pipeline reliability and deployment velocity across teams.

Solid operational experience with database technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB, including performance tuning and high-availability design.

Strong Python skills for building automation and tooling, along with solid working knowledge of AWS boto3.

**The Scope of Your Influence**

Act as a senior escalation point in the on-call rotation, leading incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues and driving thorough post-incident reviews.

Own the deployment architecture and monitoring strategy for Tally’s cloud, making the calls on design trade-offs and setting the standard other engineers follow.

Lead deployment governance and change management, driving alignment across development, testing, and operations teams on patch and release strategy, ensuring changes roll out consistently and safely across all environments (development, staging, production).

Proactively identify systemic in efficiencies and lead automation initiatives (scripting, configuration management, orchestration) that reduce manual toil across the team, not just your own workload.

Own the performance and availability of Tally's cloud-based applications, setting SLOs and driving the team's response when they're at risk.

Define, track, and improve operational KPIs including service availability, deployment success, incident response, and platform health.

**Success Measures**

Effective deployment governance through active participation in change management and release reviews.

Strong stakeholder engagement and operational communication across teams.

Continuous improvement through automation, operational excellence, and incident reduction initiatives.

Data-driven operational management through CloudOps metrics, reporting, and service health reviews.

Demonstrated leadership in driving cross-functional operational outcomes and technical excellence.

**Note:**
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the hiring process.

Join a collaborative team building and running production-grade web applications that deliver real business impact. As a Senior Consultant, you'll own platform design and operations across our Product Suite, with a focus on enablement, reliability, and maintenance. You'll apply modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery, shape infrastructure plans from the ground up, and scope and size effort estimates for prospective client engagements — all while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams. This role is based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.
  
  
IDT anticipates how technology will shape the future and begin building future capabilities and practices today, driving the ideation, incubation, and scale of hybrid businesses and tech-enabled offerings. Partnering with the broader network and brings together dreamers, designers, and builders to deliver a unique point of view and future-proof both Deloitte's business and its clients.

Cloud & Platform Architecture
  
  

* Design, plan, and architect end-to-end cloud infrastructure on AWS — VPC topology, IAM strategy, service networking, multi-account structure, and cost governance
* Own Kubernetes cluster operations across environments: provisioning, upgrades, RBAC hardening, network policies, autoscaling, and node lifecycle management

Delivery Pipelines & Automation

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role
  
  
We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.
  
  
This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.
* Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.
* Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.
* Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.
* Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.
* Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.
* Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.
* Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.

What you'll bring
  
  

* Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.
* Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.
* Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.
* Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.
* A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.
* Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.
* Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.

**About The Team**
Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Platform Engineer
description:

Hevo's platform moves and transforms data for thousands of customers, around the clock. We're looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and observability of the infrastructure that makes that possible — a senior, hands-on engineer who can both operate at depth in AWS and Kubernetes and set technical direction for the broader Platform/DevOps function.

* Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and performance of Hevo's production infrastructure on AWS, GCP and Kubernetes
* Design and evolve our observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets
* Lead incident management: on-call rotations, blameless postmortems, and systematically reducing MTTA/MTTR
* Drive infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform, Ansible) and own CI/CD pipeline design
* Architect and operate Kubernetes clusters at scale — upgrades, autoscaling, cost optimization, multi-tenant workloads
* Own network architecture and security posture for cloud infrastructure (VPCs, load balancers, service mesh, zero-trust networking)
* Partner with product engineering teams to embed reliability and operational excellence into the software lifecycle
* Mentor and uplevel other platform engineers; set technical direction and engineering best practices
* Own capacity planning and cost optimization for cloud infrastructure

**What We're Looking For — Must-Haves**

* 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform engineering roles, including meaningful time operating at Staff/Lead level
* Deep, hands-on expertise running production Kubernetes at scale
* Strong AWS expertise (EC2, VPC, EKS, RDS, IAM, networking, security groups)
* Proven track record building observability stacks (OTel, Grafana, Telegraf, Influx or similar)
* Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash)
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Ansible)
* CI/CD pipeline design and ownership (Jenkins or similar)
* Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPNs, service mesh
* Experience owning on-call/incident management and driving a strong postmortem culture
* Excellent communication skills — able to influence engineering decisions across teams without direct authority

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with multi-region or multi-cloud architectures
* Familiarity with cost optimization / FinOps practices
* Exposure to compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, GDPR)
* Prior experience at a SaaS or data infrastructure company

**About Hevo**

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA.

title: Sr Engineer - Managed Kubernetes
description:
**About Us**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
  
  
Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win
  
  
**Team Overview**
**Managed Kubernetes**
is part of Target Infrastructure Services, providing the foundational container platform for deploying and operating applications across Target data centers and public cloud environments. The platform enables engineering teams to build and operate scalable, reliable services without having to manage the complexity of the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure. Through API- and UI-driven automation, teams can provision, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes clusters at scale across on-premises and cloud environments. The platform also provides curated capabilities for security, observability, compliance, and resiliency. By providing a consistent Kubernetes experience across Target data centers and public cloud, Managed Kubernetes reduces operational complexity, improves reliability, and accelerates application and platform development across Target.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Senior Engineer – Managed Kubernetes Platform**
to design, build, and operate reliable cloud-native platform capabilities across public cloud, hybrid cloud, and on-premises environments. In this role, you will own
**Kubernetes platform components and problem spaces end-to-end, independently solve complex technical and operational problems**
, and partner with product and engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and easy-to-use platform services. You will bring deep
**Kubernetes and platform engineering expertise**
, improve how the platform performs in production, and help other engineers grow through technical guidance and constructive feedback.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own Kubernetes platform services or components through design, implementation, deployment, and production operation; make sound decisions that balance customer needs, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery constraints.
* Build and maintain platform automation, tooling, controllers, and services, primarily using Go (Golang), and contribute production-quality code with appropriate tests and clear operational behavior.
* Provision, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and optimize Kubernetes clusters and supporting infrastructure across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments, including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) where applicable.
* Design and improve Kubernetes networking and connectivity, including CNI, ingress, services, network policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and service-to-service communication.
* Automate infrastructure and platform changes using Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes tools such as Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize; implement and improve GitOps workflows with Argo CD and/or Flux.
* Improve platform observability and operations through useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, health indicators, and service thresholds; use production data to identify patterns and drive reliability and performance improvements.
* Design for failure and recovery by establishing clear failure boundaries, applying retries, timeouts, and other appropriate resilience patterns, and ensuring services degrade gracefully.
* Participate in and independently manage incidents for owned systems, coordinate investigation and resolution, communicate status clearly, and follow through on root-cause analysis and reliability improvements.
* Apply secure-by-default practices to platform services and automation, understand relevant threats, manage secrets appropriately, remediate findings, and work with security and platform partners on effective controls.
* Lead technical discussions within the team and collaborate with partner teams on multi-component designs, integrations, operational improvements, and delivery of platform capabilities.
* Review code and designs with a focus on quality, testability, security, and operational risk; provide coaching-oriented feedback and mentor engineers in Kubernetes and platform engineering practices.
* Document technical evaluations, decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures so that engineers and stakeholders can understand and support the platform.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Strong software development experience in Go (Golang), including the ability to build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain production services or platform tooling.
* Hands-on experience designing, administering, and operating Kubernetes platforms, including cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Experience operating Kubernetes on a public cloud platform; GCP and GKE experience is preferred, with AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud experience also relevant
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes architecture and networking, including CNI plugins, ingress controllers, Services, Network Policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and connectivity.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes configuration or deployment tools such as Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Experience implementing GitOps practices using tools such as Argo CD and/or Flux, and building or maintaining CI/CD automation for platform changes.
* Experience with platform observability, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, and distributed tracing, and using operational data to diagnose issues and improve services.
* Experience administering Linux systems and troubleshooting container runtime or host-level issues.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes storage, including CSI drivers, Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, Storage Classes, StatefulSets, and backup or recovery considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently investigate problems involving multiple connected components or systems, identify root causes, and implement durable improvements.
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate with business and engineering partners, and explain platform concepts to audiences with different levels of technical context.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related field, including meaningful hands-on Kubernetes experience.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification.
* Experience with multi-cluster or hybrid Kubernetes environments, cluster lifecycle automation, and platform self-service capabilities.
* Experience with disaster recovery planning, performance or capacity testing, and safe release practices such as progressive rollout and rollback.
* Experience contributing to shared engineering practices, technical learning, or open-source projects.

title: Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent a decade building systems that need to stay up, not just run, actually stay up, under production load with real users depending on them. You know that observability is not about dashboards that look good in demos, it is about catching the signal before the page goes out at 2am. You think in SLOs and error budgets because you have lived through enough incidents to know that hope is not a strategy.
  
  
You are the person who walks into a war room, pulls up three graphs, and knows exactly which service is choking and why. Linux is your native language. You have written enough Bash and Python to automate yourself out of repetitive work, and you know when to reach for Terraform or Ansible to make infrastructure repeatable. Cloud platforms like Azure do not intimidate you because you have built on them, broken things on them, and fixed them under pressure.
  
  
EDA workloads are not abstract to you. You have worked with Grid Engine, LSF, or SLURM. You understand what it means when a compute-heavy job grid starts behaving strangely, and you know how to instrument it. Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, these are not buzzwords, they are tools you have deployed, tuned, and scaled.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will build the observability backbone that keeps our Cloud and on-prem production systems visible, reliable, and ready for what comes next.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Design, build, and own the SRE and Observability platform that monitors production systems across on-prem and Azure Cloud environments, giving engineering and operations teams a real-time, holistic view of system health
  
  
Partner with product, infrastructure, and application teams to define SLAs, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and KPIs that actually matter, then instrument systems to track them
  
  
Automate deployment and configuration of monitoring tools using Terraform, Ansible, Bash, and Python to eliminate manual toil and reduce configuration drift
  
  
Build custom scripts and tooling to extend observability capabilities, including proactive remediation workflows and self-healing automation that catches issues before they become incidents
  
  
Lead root cause analysis on production incidents, write detailed postmortems for stakeholders, and drive systemic fixes that prevent recurrence
  
  
Mentor junior SREs and Cloud Operations engineers, providing technical guidance on Linux systems, observability tooling, and SRE best practices
  
  
Evaluate, test, and integrate new observability and reliability tools and technologies, including AI-assisted monitoring, copilots, and emerging patterns like MCP and RAG
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
Production systems across Synopsys Cloud will be more visible, more reliable, and easier to debug because of the observability platform you build
  
  
Engineering teams will spend less time firefighting and more time building because your automation catches problems early and fixes them without human intervention
  
  
Incident response times will drop because the right data will be surfaced at the right time, and teams will know what to look at first
  
  
SRE practices will become embedded across the organization as you define KPIs, error budgets, and reliability standards that other teams adopt
  
  
Junior engineers will grow faster because you will teach them how to think about reliability, not just react to alerts
  
  
The Cloud Operations team will scale more effectively because repeatable, automated workflows replace one-off manual fixes
  
  
Stakeholders will have confidence in production stability because postmortems and reliability metrics will be clear, honest, and actionable
  
  
**What You'll Need**
10+ years of hands-on experience in software development, system administration, or site reliability engineering with a focus on production systems
  
  
Deep expertise in Linux OS internals, networking, and NFS technologies, you should be able to troubleshoot kernel-level issues and performance bottlenecks
  
  
Strong experience with Elasticsearch for log aggregation and search, this is non-negotiable for the role
  
  
Solid programming and scripting skills in Bash and Python, with proven ability to build automation that runs in production
  
  
Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and configuration management using Ansible
  
  
Expertise in at least one major cloud platform, Azure strongly preferred, AWS or GCP also relevant
  
  
Experience working with EDA workloads and job schedulers like Grid Engine, LSF, or SLURM in production environments, experience with Prometheus and Grafana is a strong plus, familiarity with Docker, Swarm, or Kubernetes is helpful but not required
  
  
**Who You Are**
You have a proactive mindset, you spot performance bottlenecks and reliability risks before they become incidents, and you act on them without being asked
  
  
You can explain a complex system failure to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance, and you can write a postmortem that engineers and executives both find useful
  
  
You are comfortable working across teams, you know how to pull the right data from product engineers, negotiate SLOs with stakeholders, and get buy-in for automation projects
  
  
You do not need perfect requirements to move forward, you ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions, document them, and iterate as you learn more
  
  
You care about the details, monitoring configurations, alert thresholds, dashboard layouts, because you know that small mistakes in observability tooling create big problems downstream
  
  
You are someone who mentors by doing, you pair with junior engineers, review their scripts, and show them how to think through reliability tradeoffs in real time
  
  
**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will join the Synopsys Cloud infrastructure team, a group responsible for the reliability and observability of production systems running on Azure, GCP, AWS. This team builds the infrastructure that keeps EDA workloads running at scale, and your work will directly support engineering teams across the company who depend on stable, visible, and well-instrumented systems.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
