The Databricks Platform Engineer is the technical owner of our Databricks Lakehouse platform — the shared foundation on which enterprise data products, analytics, reporting and AI/ML workloads are built.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, automation, governance and cost efficiency of the Databricks platform. The successful candidate will have production experience operating Databricks as an enterprise platform, not just building on it. They will work AI-natively and set that standard for the team.
  
  
You will own the Data Platforms domain within a cross-skilled Data & Analytics Platforms engineering team. You will establish platform engineering standards, design and build infrastructure automation, create reusable reference architectures and engineering patterns, and ensure the platform can be operated reliably at enterprise scale. You will also mentor engineers and help build platform engineering capability within the India team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform ownership**

* Own workspace- and account-level architecture: Unity Catalog, compute policies, Lakeflow Jobs and shared compute infrastructure, identity and service principals, secrets management, audit logging, system tables, storage integration, platform upgrades and environment promotion across development, test and production.
* Design, build and review infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and observability capabilities for the platform, establishing reusable standards and automation for the wider engineering team.
* Own platform reliability: availability, capacity, incident management, root-cause analysis, and DR/BCP; define and meet platform SLOs for shared platform services.
* Run Databricks FinOps: consumption monitoring, cost optimisation, budget and anomaly management, and chargeback/showback with transparent unit costs for consuming teams.
* Implement platform security and governance controls: identity federation/SCIM, service principals, network controls, secrets, RBAC/ABAC, governed tags, row/column security and masking, PII handling, lineage and audit.
* Enable and operate the platform capabilities required for AI/ML workloads — MLflow, Model Serving, vector search and GenAI infrastructure patterns — partnering with analytics and AI teams on workload architecture, governance and cost controls.
* Build and maintain reference implementations and paved-road patterns (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Auto Loader) that show engineering teams how to use the platform; enable consuming teams rather than owning delivery of their data products.
* Treat the platform as an internal product: understand consuming-team needs, define paved-road capabilities and self-service patterns, track adoption and reliability, and continuously reduce developer friction.
* Own the platform roadmap: upgrades, new capabilities, deprecations.

**Engineering standards**

* Contribute to the team engineering handbook and architecture decisions; lead code reviews on platform and foundation work.
* Take part in architecture and engineering forums, communicating trade-offs clearly to peers and global stakeholders.
* Maintain reusable patterns and automation used across the team.
* Establish AI-native engineering practice for the team: how AI assistants are used for infrastructure code, test generation, runbooks, code review and troubleshooting, and where human review is mandatory.

**Mentoring and collaboration**

* Mentor engineers through onboarding, pairing and code review.
* Provide secondary coverage for an adjacent platform area as part of the team's cross-skilling model.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of professional data platform or data engineering experience, including at least 2 years administering and operating Databricks in production as an enterprise platform (account and workspace administration, Unity Catalog, compute policies, environment promotion), not only developing pipelines on it.
* Demonstrated ability to design, build and review infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD for data platforms (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline or similar).
* Strong Python and PySpark; advanced SQL.
* Experience running platform operations: monitoring and alerting, incident management, runbooks, capacity and performance management.
* Experience with Databricks cost management and FinOps practices.
* Platform security and compliance experience: identity, service principals, secrets, network controls, audit logging, RBAC and PII handling, with an understanding of controls such as SOX.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems and system design for large-scale data processing.
* Strong AWS fundamentals: S3, IAM, VPC and networking, KMS, and how Databricks integrates with them.
* Demonstrated effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools, or a strong ability and willingness to adopt them, across coding, IaC, testing, documentation and troubleshooting, with sound judgement around verification, security and human review. Specific tools are not a screening criterion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with global stakeholders and lead technical discussion.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and/or AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
* Experience operating platforms in compliance-driven environments (SOX, GxP / 21 CFR Part 11 or similar): change control, audit evidence, access reviews, segregation of duties.
* Experience supporting, onboarding or mentoring other engineers.
* Experience taking over or migrating an existing platform estate.
* Experience working in a global delivery model with distributed stakeholders.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer [T500-30125]
description:
**ABOUT UNDER ARMOUR:**

Our story is a classic American entrepreneurial journey, born from a simple, unmet need identified by an athlete. In 1996, founder Kevin Plank, then captain of the University of Maryland football team, set out to solve the problem of sweat-soaked cotton shirts by creating a moisture-wicking synthetic alternative. That innovation – HeatGear – redefined the athletic base layer and laid the foundation for what is today a global leader in performance apparel, footwear, and accessories.

Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, Under Armour is driven by a clear mission – to make all athletes better. This relentless pursuit of better defines who we are, shaping our focus on performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**OUR PURPOSE:**

Building on this global foundation, Under Armour India is purpose-built to access India’s top-tier talent and embed the brand’s culture into scalable, tech-driven solutions. At its core, this is about empowering those who strive for more – a belief reflected in our values: Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes, and Stand for Equality.

These values serve as a shared framework that guides how we think, build, and collaborate. They connect teams across geographies, reinforce our purpose, and ensure that everything we do is aligned to a common goal – enabling better outcomes for athletes and the business.

At Under Armour India, this translates into an environment where individuals have the freedom to go further, regardless of role. Teams are empowered to develop and deliver state-of-the-art products and digital solutions that enhance performance and drive impact at scale.

**VALUES & INNOVATION:**

Across Under Armour globally, our values act as the thread that unites every teammate, shaping a culture grounded in purpose, accountability, and shared ambition. They are not just principles, but active drivers of how we operate, innovate, and grow together.

This culture is deeply anchored in innovation – a continuous pursuit of better that pushes boundaries and challenges convention. Whether through product innovation or digital transformation, teams are enabled to create solutions that elevate performance and redefine possibilities for athletes everywhere.

**PURPOSE OF ROLE:**

* The Cloud DevOps Engineer is a senior individual contributor embedded within our Core Infrastructure team, serving as the critical link between our foundational cloud infrastructure and the application engineering teams who build and operate our e-commerce platform. While our Cloud Infrastructure Engineers are responsible for designing and managing the underlying AWS and GCP environments, the Cloud DevOps Engineer is responsible for making those environments accessible, usable, and productive for the broader engineering organization.
* This role exists because world-class infrastructure alone is not sufficient — the tools, pipelines, and workflows that sit on top of that infrastructure determine whether engineering teams can move quickly and ship with confidence. In a retail environment where deployment frequency, release quality, and system availability directly affect customer experience and commercial performance, the Cloud DevOps Engineer plays a decisive role in our ability to compete and grow.
* A distinguishing aspect of this role is hands-on ownership of our edge delivery and security layer. The Cloud DevOps Engineer will be responsible for integrating Fastly CDN and Signal Sciences (Fastly Next-Gen WAF) into our deployment pipelines and operational workflows, ensuring that edge configuration changes are version-controlled, tested, and deployed with the same rigor and repeatability as application code.
* The Cloud DevOps Engineer sits within the broader Infrastructure team alongside Cloud Infrastructure Engineers and reports into the same leadership structure but operates with a distinct and complementary mandate. Where Infrastructure Engineers focus on provisioning, managing, and securing the cloud environment itself, the DevOps Engineer focuses on the delivery layer — the CI/CD pipelines, deployment frameworks, container orchestration workflows, edge configuration management, and observability tooling that application teams interact with daily.
* The successful candidate will bring deep hands-on experience across CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes, edge delivery, and cloud-native tooling, combined with a genuine passion for developer experience, automation, and operational excellence.

**YOUR IMPACT (Job Responsibilities):**

* Consume and build upon the foundational infrastructure provisioned by the Infrastructure Engineering team, translating it into developer-facing platform capabilities
* Act as the primary point of contact for application engineering teams seeking guidance on deployment, release management, and pipeline architecture
* Serve as the operational owner of Fastly CDN and Signal Sciences configurations, working closely with Infrastructure Engineers and the Security team to ensure edge policies are aligned with infrastructure and security standards
* Collaborate closely with Infrastructure Engineers on shared concerns including secrets management, IAM permissions, network policies, and environment configuration
* Serve as an advocate for developer experience within infrastructure planning discussions, ensuring that new infrastructure capabilities are designed with usability and automation in mind
* Contribute to shared infrastructure initiatives including observability stack ownership, environment standardization, and platform reliability
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reliable, and auditable software delivery across our e-commerce platform, working in close coordination with Infrastructure Engineers who manage the underlying compute and network environments
* Manage and optimize containerized workload delivery using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), collaborating with Infrastructure Engineers on cluster configuration, networking, and scaling policies
* Implement and maintain GitOps workflows using tools such as ArgoCD or Flux to ensure consistent, version-controlled deployment practices across environments
* Own the operational management of Fastly CDN, including service configuration, VCL development and maintenance, cache policy management, and the integration of Fastly configuration changes into CI/CD pipelines as code
* Administer and iterate on Signal Sciences / Fastly Next-Gen WAF rules, thresholds, and alerting policies, working in close collaboration with the Security team to ensure application traffic is protected against evolving threats without impacting legitimate customer traffic
* Develop and maintain automated testing and deployment workflows for Fastly and Signal Sciences configuration changes, ensuring that edge updates can be promoted across environments with the same safety and auditability as application deployments
* Build and maintain observability tooling including logging pipelines, metrics dashboards, and alerting frameworks using Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent platforms, incorporating Fastly and Signal Sciences log streams as first-class data sources
* Partner with Infrastructure Engineers to integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), IAM policies, and network security controls into CI/CD workflows and deployment pipelines
* Support capacity planning and edge readiness preparation ahead of peak retail events including seasonal promotions, flash sales, and new market launches
* Serve as a technical resource and enablement partner for application engineering teams, providing guidance on CI/CD best practices, containerization, edge delivery, and cloud-native deployment patterns
* On call duties as needed

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 10+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering role, ideally within a high-traffic e-commerce or digital retail environment
* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP, with a solid understanding of the services most relevant to application delivery including EKS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront, and IAM
* Strong proficiency with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or Jenkins, including pipeline design, optimization, and governance
* Experience with Terraform or OpenTofu for infrastructure-as-code, with the ability to contribute to and consume shared infrastructure modules maintained by the Infrastructure Engineering team
* Solid working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes including deployment management, resource configuration, RBAC, and networking
* Hands-on experience with Fastly CDN, including service configuration, VCL authoring, cache behavior management, and the automation of Fastly configuration changes through CI/CD pipelines
* Demonstrated experience with Signal Sciences / Fastly Next-Gen WAF, including rule management, threshold tuning, traffic analysis, and integration of WAF alerting into operational workflows and incident response processes
* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux for managing application deployments in a declarative, auditable manner
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, or Go) for automation and tooling development
* Hands-on experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or Open Telemetry including dashboard creation, alerting configuration, and log management
* Cloud or DevOps certifications including AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or GCP Professional DevOps Engineer

You'll work across both, with most of your focus on GCP, partnering closely with software engineers throughout.

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools, preferably Datadog and Grafana.

title: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer (SMTS)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) in DevOps to build and run the infrastructure behind our energy and IoT platform. The SMTS will own AWS and Kubernetes in production, keep services reliable, and make sure we get maximum value from every rupee of cloud spend.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. It requires strong DevOps and AWS capability, deep Docker and Kubernetes experience in production, a proven record of cloud cost optimisation, and site reliability practice covering SLOs, observability and incident response. Strong programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Go or Java are essential, because automation here is built as software. This is an AI-native engineering environment: AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor are part of the daily workflow. The role requires 5+ years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

**AWS & Infrastructure**

* Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure across compute, networking, storage, managed databases and IAM, with ownership of resilience and security posture.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, using review, testing and versioning like any other software.
* Manage networking, VPC design, DNS, load balancing and access control across environments.
* Partner with security on secrets management, patching, vulnerability scanning and least-privilege access.

**Docker & Kubernetes**

* Own Kubernetes clusters in production, including upgrades, autoscaling, resource management, networking and multi-environment setup.
* Define container standards with Docker: lean images, secure base images and consistent build practices.
* Package and deploy services with Helm or equivalent, and drive GitOps practices where they help.
* Troubleshoot workloads across pods, nodes, networking and storage.

**Cost Optimisation**

* Own AWS and Kubernetes cost visibility, with tagging, dashboards and per-service cost attribution.
* Reduce spend through rightsizing, autoscaling, Spot and Graviton usage, Savings Plans, storage lifecycle policies and removal of idle resources.
* Review architecture and capacity decisions for cost impact before they reach production.
* Report cost trends and savings to engineering leadership with clear recommendations.

**Site Reliability**

* Define and track SLIs and SLOs for critical services, and use them to guide reliability work.
* Build monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting that is actionable rather than noisy.
* Lead incident response, run blameless post-mortems and drive fixes for recurring causes.
* Plan capacity and run load and failure testing before peak demand or major releases.
* Write runbooks and automate repetitive operational work so on-call stays sustainable.

**CI/CD & Automation**

* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, safe rollouts and fast rollback.
* Write production-quality automation and internal tooling in Python, Go or Java rather than relying on ad hoc scripts.
* Mentor engineers on deployment, observability and production ownership.
* Use Claude Code, Cursor and equivalent AI coding agents for infrastructure code, automation and log analysis, and review AI-assisted changes carefully.

**THE ENVIRONMENT**

**Technology Environment**

* Cloud: AWS (EC2, EKS, VPC, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch).
* Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or equivalent.
* CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Argo CD.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki and Sentry.
* Cost Management: AWS Cost Explorer, Kubecost or equivalent.
* Programming: Python, Go, Java and Bash.
* Services Supported: Java, Spring Boot, Python, Django, FastAPI and Node.js.
* Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, MQTT and Apache Flink.
* AI Tooling: Claude Code and Cursor.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential: DevOps & AWS**

* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform or site reliability engineering for production systems.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience across compute, networking, storage, managed databases and IAM.
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines built and maintained first-hand.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals.

**Essential: Docker & Kubernetes**

* Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster-level ownership rather than only deploying to it.
* Strong Docker and container fundamentals, including image security and build optimisation.

**Essential: Cost Optimisation & Site Reliability**

* Demonstrated cloud cost reduction with measurable savings.
* Experience defining SLOs, building monitoring and alerting, and participating in on-call.
* Incident response and post-mortem experience on customer-impacting issues.
* Strong debugging across application, container, network and infrastructure layers.

**Essential: Programming**

* Strong coding ability in at least one language such as Python, Go or Java, writing maintainable automation and tooling rather than only shell scripts.

**Essential: Ways of Working**

* Ability to work independently and bring clarity to ambiguous operational problems.
* Clear written communication across runbooks, post-mortems and design documents.
* Bias towards fixing causes rather than symptoms, and automating rather than repeating.
* Fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent AI development tools in daily engineering work.

**Desirable**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer or CKA certification.
* GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.
* Operating Kafka, Flink or time-series databases in production.
* Chaos engineering or disaster recovery planning.
* Security and compliance practices such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. IoT, energy, industrial or real-time data platforms

title: Staff Devops Engg
description:
**Staff DevOps Engineer**
**About the Role**
LeadSquared serves thousands of businesses around the world, each with its own requirements for data residency, latency, and compliance. CloudOps runs the infrastructure behind all of it: the production estate that serves customers today, the shared services every product team depends on, and the modern platform that new products are built on.
  
  
We're hiring a
**Staff DevOps Engineer**
to set the technical direction for infrastructure across the whole LeadSquared platform. This is not a ticket queue role. You'll decide how a new environment comes up, how tenants are isolated, how a production change is reviewed and rolled out, how existing workloads move to more modern foundations without disrupting customers, and how we know something is broken before a customer tells us. Then you'll build those systems and make sure they keep working after you move on to the next problem.
  
  
You'll work across CloudOps, every product engineering team, Security, and Engineering leadership. Your influence will reach well beyond the code you write yourself.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Architecture: Set the long-term direction for LeadSquared's cloud infrastructure across all products and environments through design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). Lead migrations from today's estate to a standardised platform without customer impact.
* Infrastructure as Code: Bring all infrastructure under reviewed code with safe change practices, including PR-driven plan and apply, policy as code, drift detection, and production guardrails.
* Runtime and Delivery: Own the compute, Kubernetes, and CI/CD platforms so that shipping a service or onboarding a tenant becomes self-service.
* Reliability: Define SLOs, own observability, lead major incidents and postmortems, and regularly test disaster recovery.
* Security and Compliance: Enforce least-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption by default. Support audits through automated evidence collection.
* Cost Optimisation: Treat cloud spend as an engineering metric, with visibility into costs per product, tenant, and service.
* Leadership: Mentor engineers, represent CloudOps to product teams, and eliminate operational toil through automation.

**What We're Looking For**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering, with clear ownership of production systems at meaningful scale.
* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise, including multi-account organisations, networking, IAM, compute, containers, managed data services, and edge delivery.
* Expert-level Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or equivalent tools, including designing reusable modules and structuring code across multiple environments.
* Expert-level Kubernetes experience in production, including cluster upgrades, autoscaling, networking, RBAC, and debugging under pressure.
* Production experience with CI/CD and GitOps practices.
* Experience running and migrating a large, existing production estate, not just building greenfield environments.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language, with the ability to build production-grade tooling.
* A track record of leading incidents, writing postmortems, and delivering the reliability improvements that follow.
* Proven ability to write clear technical documents and influence decisions across teams without formal authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing or operating highly available, active-active, or disaster recovery (DR) architectures in the cloud.
* Experience leading large-scale migrations, such as moving from virtual machines to containers, with zero or near-zero customer impact.
* Experience building an observability practice with SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience with policy as code and software supply chain security.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms, including tenant isolation models, per-tenant routing, and capacity management.
* FinOps experience with demonstrable cloud cost reductions.
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling or public speaking and writing on platform engineering.

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 90 Days**

* Understand LeadSquared's infrastructure end to end across products, accounts, and environments, and join the on-call and incident commander rotation.
* Deliver at least one meaningful improvement to change safety or developer experience across teams.
* Produce a written assessment of the platform's top reliability, security, and cost risks, along with a proposed roadmap.

**First Year**

* New environments can be provisioned from code in days, not weeks.
* Most production infrastructure is managed as code and changed only through reviewed pull requests.
* SLOs are defined for critical customer journeys, alerting is driven by them, and error budgets inform release decisions.
* Disaster recovery has been tested end to end, with documented results.
* Cloud spend per unit of load is measurably lower.
* At least two engineers on the team are operating at the next level as a result of your mentorship.

**How We Work**

* Everything is code, everything is reviewed: Infrastructure changes go through pull requests, plans are visible, and production applies are deliberate.
* Standards over snowflakes: One consistent way to build an environment, deploy a service, and manage observability.
* Blameless by default: Incidents are opportunities to improve systems, not to blame people.
* Writing is how we decide: Design documents and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) come before major changes.

LeadSquared is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

**The Opportunity**
Planview is hiring a
**DevOps Engineer in Bengaluru, India to support Planview SaaS applications across the product line, including the Windows Server-based environments that run them**
. You will work in a global, collaborative team, owning CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and automation to keep deployments fast and systems reliable
**.**
**What You'll Do**

* Administer and support Windows Server environments (2016, 2019, 2022) on AWS EC2, including server builds, configuration, hardening, patching, and day-to-day troubleshooting.
* Manage IIS-hosted applications and Windows services: sites, application pools, bindings, certificates, scheduled tasks, and service accounts.
* Support Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy for domain-joined servers, including access, permissions (NTFS and share), and authentication issues.
* Patch and maintain Windows fleets using AWS Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Run Command) or WSUS, with safe rollout, validation, and rollback practices.
* Diagnose Windows performance and stability issues using Event Viewer, Performance Monitor, and PowerShell (CPU, memory, disk, network, services, and application errors).
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins for reliable, fast delivery, including deployments to Windows hosts.
* Manage containerized workloads on Docker and ECS: task definitions, services, and clusters.
* Provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform (CloudFormation a plus), including Windows AMIs, EC2 bootstrapping, and domain join.
* Automate configuration and deployment tasks using Python and PowerShell (Ansible a plus).
* Set up and maintain monitoring and alerting via New Relic (CloudWatch, Datadog, or Prometheus/Grafana a plus), including Windows host metrics and Event Log forwarding.
* Write Shell, PowerShell, and Python scripts to automate operations and reduce manual work.
* Manage Git workflows: branching, merge strategies, and pull request reviews.
* Administer and support MSSQL databases running on Windows and on Amazon RDS, including backups, restores, and basic performance troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot deployment, performance, and infrastructure issues with development teams.
* Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident response, including Windows server and IIS incidents.
* Continuously improve infrastructure resilience and deployment speed.
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up IaC authoring, pipeline debugging, and day-to-day scripting.

**What You'll Bring**

* Experience: 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, with strong hands-on Windows Server administration.
* OS (Windows): Windows Server administration, including:

+ Roles and features, services, processes, and scheduled tasks
+ IIS (sites, app pools, bindings, SSL certificates, logs and common HTTP errors)
+ Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy fundamentals; NTFS and share permissions
+ Windows Firewall, RDP, and remote administration (PowerShell remoting, WinRM)
+ Event Viewer, Performance Monitor, and performance and disk troubleshooting
+ Patching, hardening, and backup/recovery practices

* Scripting (Windows): PowerShell for automation, with Bash and Python.
* Cloud: AWS (Active Directory, ECS, EC2 including Windows instances, CloudFront, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, Lambda basics, Systems Manager).
* Source Control: Git: branching, merge/rebase, PR reviews.
* CI/CD (Jenkins): Pipeline creation and basic Groovy scripting.
* Containerization (Docker + ECS): Task definitions, services, and clusters.
* IaC: Terraform.
* Monitoring: New Relic.
* Networking Basics: DNS, load balancers, security groups, VPNs.
* Logging: ELK stack / CloudWatch Logs (including Windows Event Logs).
* Database: MSSQL administration: backups, restores, basic performance troubleshooting (SQL Server on Windows and RDS for SQL Server).
* Infrastructure Automation: Hands-on experience automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployment end-to-end.
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Comfortable working with AI coding/DevOps assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) for IaC generation, scripting, and troubleshooting.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Windows image building and configuration: EC2 Image Builder or Packer for Windows AMIs, PowerShell DSC, Chocolatey.
* Windows containers and Server Core experience.
* AWS Managed Microsoft AD or hybrid AD integration.
* Configuration Management: Ansible.
* Additional IaC: CloudFormation.
* Architecture: Knowledge of microservices architecture.
* Cloudflare: DNS, CDN, WAF.
* Artifact Repositories: Nexus, JFrog Artifactory, ECR.
* Other CI/CD Tools: GitHub Actions.
* AWS cost optimization / FinOps awareness.
* Datadog, CloudWatch, or Prometheus/Grafana.
* AIOps: Exposure to AI-driven anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, or incident triage (e.g., Dynatrace Davis AI, Datadog Bits AI, Harness AIDA).Database Basics: RDS backups, restores, performance tuning

**Benefits At Planview**
At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy:
  
  

* Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax.
* Generous PTO offerings (region dependent).
* Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support.
* Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week.
* Employee Referral bonus program.
* Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events.
* Flexible work hours/environment.

Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you!
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
Planview may employ AI-based tools to support certain recruiting activities, however all decisions affecting a candidate's application are made by a human recruiter or hiring manager. Planview is committed to complying with applicable AI regulations, including the EU AI Act and other emerging legislation in the jurisdictions in which we operate, and reviews its AI practices as these requirements evolve. If you require further information or would like to exercise your rights under applicable privacy laws, please submit your request at the Planview Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Portal.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
**Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, apps, and streaming. Conviva pioneered quality of experience measurement for streaming video and has supported live digital experiences across 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. With full-census, real-time, stateful analytics, Conviva shows what consumers actually experience, not just whether systems are running, and connects that experience to revenue, retention, and risk.**

We are looking for a dynamic, growth-minded DevOps Engineer with over 8 years of experience to bridge the gap between our traditional on-premises infrastructure and our expanding multi cloud footprint (AWS, GCP, and OCI). Here is the honest truth: we don't expect you to be an absolute master of all three clouds and bare-metal setups on day one. We value your learning trajectory (your slope) over your current baseline knowledge (your intercept). If you have rock-solid systems fundamentals, a passion for automation, an unstoppable drive to figure things out, and a knack for deep-dive debugging, you will thrive here.

**What Success Will Look Like:**

* Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Orchestration: Assist in managing, scaling, and maintaining our on-premises infrastructure while expanding and supporting environments across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM): Design, implement, and audit secure authentication and authorization workflows (OIDC, SAML, Cloud IAM, Least Privilege policies) across hybrid environments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure safe, repeatable, and rapid code deployments.
* Observability & Debugging: Set up comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems. You will be the detective who tracks down root causes when complex, distributed systems misbehave.
* SecOps Integration: Embed security best practices directly into the infrastructure lifecycle (vulnerability scanning, secrets management, compliance-as-code).

**Who You Are and What You've Done:**

Technical Baseline (The Intercept)

* Experience: 8+ years in a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Engineering role.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid hands-on experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.
* Operating Systems: Strong Linux administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, routing) for both cloud and physical hardware.
* Cloud Platforms: Foundational or deep experience in at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or OCI), with a strong conceptual understanding of how to translate those skills to the others.
* Containers: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (managed or bare-metal).
* Tooling Preferences: Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch), CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), and Secrets Management (HashiCorp Vault).

Growth Mindset (The Slope)

* Rapid Adaptation: The ability to pick up a completely new cloud provider or tool within weeks and apply it effectively.
* First-Principles Thinking: When an application fails, you don't just restart it; you want to understand why it failed at the OS or network level.
* Automation First: A strong aversion to manual, repetitive tasks; you automate yourself out of a job wherever possible.

Why You'll Love Working Here

* Uncapped Learning: You will gain rare, highly sought-after experience working across three major cloud providers and physical on-prem infrastructure simultaneously.
* High Autonomy: We trust our engineers. You will have the freedom to research, propose, and implement modern tools and methodologies.
* A Culture of Growth: We embrace mistakes as learning opportunities. We care about how fast you grow, not just what you knew yesterday.

conviva.ai

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
* Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
* Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
* Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
* Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
* Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
* Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery.
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python.
* Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery.
* Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus.
* Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery.
* Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades.
* Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale.
* Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects.

NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms have made major impact to various fields is broadly used across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and industry, including the world’s largest Internet companies. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on more of these unique opportunities in deep learning cloud solutions. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

 Engineering \- Our engineering team is at the core of our products – connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks and enabling secure access to all on\-prem and cloud applications. They are constantly innovating – challenging the way we, and the industry, think about Access and security. These engineers aren’t shy about building products to solve problems no one has pursued before.

 Join the Cortex DevOps Production group as a Staff DevOps Engineer, collaborating directly with the Cortex Cyber Security Research team. You will be responsible for planning, executing, and reporting on critical infrastructure and code projects. Additionally, you will orchestrate high\-pressure production maintenance and ensure seamless service reliability. This role empowers you to drive scalable infrastructure solutions in a dynamic, cutting\-edge cybersecurity environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Take full end\-to\-end responsibility for the AWS\-deployed SaaS production environment.
* Build innovative tools for the automatic remediation of known production issues.
* Develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) to orchestrate both production and development environments.
* Design, maintain, and scale production services across thousands of Kubernetes clusters.
* Secure production environments by integrating internal and market\-leading security tools.
* Collaborate with development teams to enhance architecture for scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation processes.
* Participate in on\-call rotations to support critical applications and infrastructure.
* Research and deploy cutting\-edge technologies into the production environment.


****Qualifications****
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role, ensuring high reliability.
* High proficiency with Linux operating systems.
* Strong proficiency in AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Terraform and HashiCorp tools.
* High proficiency with virtualized and containerized environments, specifically Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience managing and scaling high\-volume production environments.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Proficiency with programming languages such as Python or Go.
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Proficiency with CI/CD and Configuration Management tools, preferably Jenkins.
* Experience with databases and messaging systems like PostgreSQL, Cassandra, and Kafka.
* Proven ability to quickly grasp new technologies and prioritize multiple responsibilities.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Launched in 2018, YouTrip has swiftly ascended as a powerhouse, orchestrating billions in transactions annually and securing the trust of millions. With innovative solutions like YouTrip for consumers and YouBiz for businesses, we offer unmatched financial ease and cost\-effectiveness. Your role is pivotal in enhancing our software delivery processes and maintaining a reliable infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of technology, collaborating with development teams to streamline the deployment, delivery, and management of software products. * Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure solutions on AWS, leveraging best practices for scalability, reliability, and security

* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI/CD
* Proficiency in infrastructure provisioning tools like Terraform
* Deep knowledge of AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail
* Proven track record of leading technical projects, mentoring junior team members, and driving initiatives to successful completion
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment, with a passion for learning and staying current with emerging technologies and best practices in cloud computing and DevOps
* Strong commitment to security best practices and compliance standards, with experience implementing and maintaining security controls in AWS environments

title: Director, DevSecOps (AI-First)
description:
If you've spent the last decade building platform and security in fast\-moving product companies, and lately found yourself thinking"most of what my team does could be an agent"— this is the role.
 



**The tension we're hiring you to resolve** 




 Jupiter is a regulated fintech. \~370 repos, \~50 engineers, live money moving 24×7, RBI\-supervised partnerships (CSB, Federal), PCI\-DSS card issuance, DPDP obligations, a multi\-cloud AWS \+ OCI estate, dozens of Account Aggregator and bureau integrations. Under normal physics, you'd staff this surface with a 15\-person platform team plus a 15\-person AppSec org — the size of our entire engineering team.
 



**We don't want either.** 




 We already run one of the most AI\-augmented pipelines in Indian fi ntech — our internal agent
 



 Jarvis ships real code, triages alerts, and reviews PRs across the whole estate every day. Our engineers move fast because the paved road is intelligent. We want the same for platform and security together. That's your job.
 



**What "AI\-first DevSecOps" means at Jupiter** 




 Not "we bought a Copilot license.
 


* " It means: Deployment orchestration, capacity planning, incident triage, CVE work, threat modeling, IaC review, cost anomaly detection — all designed as agent loops first, human\-supervised and continuously improved
* Every "senior SRE would have caught this rollback" and every "senior AppSec would have caught this XSS" becomes a repeatable, evaluated agent check — codified, not tribal
* Deploy latency, incident MTTR, security\-review latency, unit cost per transaction —metrics you drive down quarterly, not queues you defend
* Auditors and partners get automated evidence packs, not spreadsheet marathons



**What you'll actually own** 




**Platform / DevOps** 



* The paved road for shipping: CI/CD, Spinnaker deploy pipelines, build systems, feature flags, release gates
* Cloud \+ Kubernetes across a multi\-cloud estate (AWS \+ OCI, multiple accounts); IaC (Terraform \+Terragrunt for cloud, Helm 3 \+ Kustomize for K8s) as the source of truth
* Observability platform: logs, metrics, traces, alerting as a product engineers want to use
* SRE practice: on\-call, incident command, error budgets, capacity \+ cost engineering
* Developer experience: local dev, preview environments, secrets provisioning, self\-serve infra



**Security** 



* AppSec paved road: SAST / DAST / SBOM / secret\-scan / IaC scan/dependency CVE triage —as PR checks that don't get routed around
* Cloud \+ K8s security posture; IAM boundaries, network segmentation for partner integrations
* Threat modeling on every new service touching money, PII, or a partner API
* Incident response: detection, containment, forensics, post\-mortems
* RBI cyber framework, PCI\-DSS, DPDP — as artifacts your pipelines emit, not documents your team writes; future\-ready for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 when we choose to pursue them
* Direct interface with banking partners and regulators on our security \+ reliability posture



**Experience \& background we're looking for** 



* Non\-negotiable 15\+ years total in software engineering, of which 8\+ years hands\-on across DevOps / Platform / SRE and Application / Cloud Security (real depth in both — not "managed a team that did it")
* 6\+ years leading engineering teams, at least 2 as second\-line (managing managers or senior ICs)
* 3\+ years in a regulated industry — fintech, banking, healthtech, or an equivalent audit\-heavyenvironment. You've been through at least one RBI / PCI\-DSS (or equivalent) audit as an owner, not a bystander. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 experience is a plus.
* Deep AWS \+ Kubernetes production experience (multi\-account, IAM, VPC, EKS, IaC via Terraform / Terragrunt \+ Helm / Kustomize). OCI experience is a plus.
* Hands\-on with modern LLM tooling (Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks) for real engineering work — you've shipped or heavily used AI dev tools in the last 12 months, not just experimented
* Can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript comfortably; write Python fluently



**Strong plus** 



* Previously built the DevSecOps function at an Indian fintech under RBI supervision
* Ran incident command for a Sev\-1 that touched customer money — and led the post\-mortem
* Public work: OSS contributions to security or platform tooling, conference talks, technical blog with depth
* Certifications: CISSP / CCSP / OSCP (security), CKA / CKS (Kubernetes), AWS Security Specialty nice signals but we care about what you've shipped, not what you've certified
* History of hiring and retaining strong ICs (references we can call)



**Explicit non\-requirements** 



* MBA / management degree — irrelevant here
* Big\-Tech (FAANG) tenure — nice signal, not required; we've seen more Jupiter\-fit talent from product startups than from BigCo
* Prior "Director" title — if you're a Principal / Staff who's been operating at Director scope, apply



**You know it's you if…** 



* You've shipped platform tooling and security tooling that engineers didn't route around both
* You can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript, and you write Python without thinking about it
* You've owned an on\-call rota you'd want to be on
* You've been hands\-on with Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks for real work — not just chat
* You've run platform or security in a regulated environment and know what a real audit feels like
* You believe the future infra \+ security leader is 30% engineer, 30% agent\-builder, 40% coach —and you're excited about the middle 30%



**You should probably skip this if…** 



* You want to lead a large team from day one (small strong team, senior\-IC\-heavy, is by design)
* You prefer governance to building
* You're skeptical that agents can do meaningful platform or security work — we'd rather hire someone who's already proven it to themselves
* You want to specialize in only one side (only Sec, only DevOps) — the whole point of this role is one strong leader across both



**The offer** 



* Reports directly to the President.
* Board\-level visibility on infra \+ security posture.
* Small strong team, budget to build (tooling, agents, headcount as we scale).
* Bangalore, work from office.
* Comp calibrated to senior director / VP band at leading Indian fintechs.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**

+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**

**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.

* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.

title: Software Development Engineer III — Risk Tech
description:
**Our journey so far** 




 Jupiter was founded in 2019 by Jitendra Gupta. Best known as Citrus Pay’s founder, Jiten found himself wondering why personal finance experiences were not customer\-centric when everything else like food ordering and entertainment were. That’s how our journey began in 2019, with a simple, powerful idea: to create a modern, customer\-centric experience that empowers individuals when it comes to their money.
 



  





 From our humble beginnings, we've strived relentlessly to make managing money easier. In 2021 when we launched we had a waitlist with over 100,000 people eager to experience the world of Jupiter \- and within 10 months we crossed 1 million users. Today, we have 2\.8 million\+ happy users on Jupiter
 



  





 Our Insights feature today tells how much and where you’ve been spending automatically, even on your other savings accounts! Our Edge CSB Bank RuPay credit card is getting a lot of love for it’s head\-turning transparent design, not to mention it being a rewarding experience. Our No\-Penalty SIP and Daily SIP at Rs 10/\- has helped scale our investments business and we have over 100,000 users investing on our platform to fulfill their money aspirations.
 



  





 We've embraced cutting\-edge technology, harnessed the power of data analytics, and assembled a diverse team of creative thinkers and industry experts who share our vision for a more accessible, transparent, and inclusive financial ecosystem. We’re now looking for like\-minded folks to join the crew.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Risk Tech is the engine room of Jupiter's lending business. Every rupee we disburse passes through systems this team owns: underwriting, eligibility, KYC, pre\-disbursal checks, fraud prevention, and pricing while decisioning in real time across our Loans and Cards ecosystems, within the regulatory guardrails of our banking and NBFC partners.
 



 As an SDE\-3 on this team, you won't just build features on the risk platform, you'll own the architecture of the systems that decide who gets credit, how much, and at what price. You'll set the technical direction for real\-time decisioning at scale, make the design calls that others build on, and raise the bar for reliability in a domain where a bad deploy has both a financial and a regulatory cost.This is a high\-ownership, high\-leverage role for someone who wants their engineering decisions to move the business, not just the codebase. This role will be owning larger swathes of the risk platform and setting technical direction across the team.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Own risk decisioning systems end\-to\-end — architect and evolve the platform combining bureau, income,fraud, and third\-party signals into real\-time underwriting and pricing decisions.
 



 • Lead the rule\-engine architecture that lets risk and policy teams configure and roll out strategies
 



 dynamically, shrinking the time from policy idea to production decision.
 



 • Design for co\-lending and multi\-lender models — build pricing and underwriting flows that support per\-entity policy, co\-lending splits, and fast partner onboarding as we scale our lending partners.
 



 • Build fraud\-prevention infrastructure — cross\-product systems (e.g. negative databases, identifier\-blocking,velocity and device signals) that protect the Loans and Cards ecosystems without adding friction for good users.
 



 • Set the standard for scale and reliability — own latency, throughput, and correctness for systems processing tens of thousands of decisions a day, where downtime and defects carry real financial and compliance risk.
 



 • Drive experimentation infrastructure for pricing and risk policies, enabling controlled rollouts and
 



 measurable yield improvements.
 



 • Make the hard architecture calls in ambiguous, cross\-team problems — data models, event\-driven contracts, service boundaries — and bring the rest of engineering along with you.
 



 • Mentor SDE\-1s and SDE\-2s, review designs and code, and raise the overall engineering bar of the team.
 



 • Partner deeply with Risk, Analytics, Product, and Compliance — translate credit policy, regulatory
 



 requirements (RBI, partner bank/NBFC guardrails), and fraud strategy into robust, auditable systems.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 • 6\+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, high\-scale systems end\-to\-end.
 



 • Strong command of Java and Spring Boot and clean, production\-grade system design on the JVM.
 



 • Deep, hands\-on PostgreSQL expertise — advanced query design and tuning, indexing strategy, execution\-plan analysis, transactions and isolation, schema design, and diagnosing performance under real production load. This is a core, non\-negotiable strength for the role.
 



 • Deep experience with event\-driven and distributed architectures — Kafka, queues/streams (SQS, SNS, EventBridge or similar), idempotency, eventual consistency.
 



 • Breadth across the wider data layer beyond PostgreSQL — NoSQL (DynamoDB) and analytical/search stores (ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) — and sound judgment on which store fits which access pattern at scale.
 



 • Advanced working experience with a public cloud (AWS preferred) and the Kubernetes ecosystem —deploying, scaling, and operating containerized services in production, not just consuming managed services.
 



 • Experience building low\-latency, high\-reliability real\-time systems — caching (Redis/ElastiCache) and a strong instinct for failure modes under load.
 



 • Hands\-on with a monitoring and alerting stack — Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting/on\-call systems — with the instinct to instrument systems so problems surface before users feel them.
 



 • Demonstrated technical leadership — you've owned architecture for a significant system, influenced peers,and driven decisions across teams, not just within your own scope.
 



 • Comfort operating in ambiguity — you can take a fuzzy business problem and turn it into a clear technical plan.
 



  





**Strong plus** 




 • Scala preferred, but not required — strong functional\-programming fundamentals in a modern JVM language are what matter most. Solid Kotlin, or idiomatic Java 17\+/21 (records, sealed types, pattern matching, streams), is a strong signal you'll pick up our Scala quickly.
 



 • Experience in fintech, lending, or risk/underwriting systems — bureau data, FOIR/eligibility logic, KYC, pre\-disbursal checks, or credit pricing.
 



 • Familiarity with co\-lending / multi\-lender architectures and partner integrations.
 



 • Exposure to fraud prevention systems and signals.
 



 • Rule\-engine or policy\-configuration platforms.
 



 • Delivery tooling: Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Spinnaker), and workflow orchestration (Airflow).
 



  





**What sets an SDE\-3 apart here — and the path to SDE\-4** 




 We hire SDE\-3s for judgment and leverage, not just throughput. At this level we expect you to:
 



 • Own outcomes, not tickets — you're accountable for whether a system works in production and moves the business, end\-to\-end.
 



 • Design what others build on — your architecture decisions define the constraints and interfaces for the rest of the team.
 



 • Reduce ambiguity for everyone else — you turn unclear, cross\-functional problems into clear technical direction.
 



 • Multiply the team — through mentorship, design review, and the standards you set and defend.
 



 • Balance speed with rigor — in a regulated, money\-moving domain, you know when to move fast and when correctness and auditability come first.
 



  





 The path for risk tech person is about widening that scope: from owning a system to owning a domain, from influencing your team to setting technical direction across Risk Tech, and from solving hard problems to shaping which problems we take on. We want someone who's ready to grow into that.
 



  





**Why Risk Tech at Jupiter** 




 You'll work at the intersection of engineering, credit risk, fraud, and regulation—where the problems are genuinely hard, and the impact is measurable in disbursals, approval rates, loss rates, and yield. The systems you build directly shape Jupiter's lending business, and you'll have the ownership to build them right

 An overview of this role
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager, you’ll guide GitLab’s dedicated Software Supply Chain Security (SSCS) Add\-On engineering team as it develops core capabilities including Dependency Firewall, Build Provenance, Malicious Packages detection, and Artifact Signing. This is a founding management role where you’ll help shape how the team works, partner closely with the Staff Backend Engineer, Product Manager, and SSCS stage management, and turn a defined roadmap into steady, high\-quality delivery for enterprise customers with strict security and compliance needs. You’ll focus on developing the team, creating a healthy operating rhythm, and establishing predictable execution for the SSCS SKU.
   

  

 You’ll join a product area where customers in regulated industries are already validating the need, and your work will help GitLab deliver software supply chain security features that customers can rely on. While technical credibility matters, your main focus will be growing a strong backend engineering team, enabling team members in their development, and creating the conditions for long\-term delivery and quality.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Guide a backend engineering team building the SSCS Add\-On across dependency enforcement, build provenance, malicious package detection, and artifact signing.
* Be responsible for Drive engineering delivery for general availability milestones by aligning sequencing, scope, and dependencies with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager.
* Develop the team by partnering with Talent Acquisition on sourcing, interview design, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
* Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations that enable growth and clear expectations.
* Advance engineering quality by monitoring cycle time, defect rates, and test coverage, and by addressing risks early.
* Coordinate quarterly planning and roadmap tradeoff discussions with SSCS stage leadership and Product.
* Work with Finance and other partners on headcount pacing and team planning as the Add\-On scales.
* Represent the SSCS Add\-On team within stage leadership discussions and help ensure strong communication across functions.


 What you’ll bring
   

  

* Over 3 years of experience guiding backend product engineering teams in security, DevOps, or platform engineering environments.
* Ability to hire and grow backend or security engineers in distributed team environments, with practical understanding of the talent landscape for these roles.
* Technical credibility to contribute to architecture discussions involving package registries, CI/CD pipeline security, and signing infrastructure.
* Experience managing predictable delivery across multi\-quarter product roadmaps and managing cross\-team dependencies.
* Comfort working in an asynchronous, documentation\-driven organization with clear written communication.
* Familiarity with supply chain security, artifact management, or compliance\-focused product areas, or transferable experience from related domains.
* Working knowledge of concepts related to frameworks and ecosystems such as SLSA and Sigstore.
* Ability to build credibility with engineers, product partners, and customer\-facing stakeholders through clear judgment, coaching, and teamwork.

 The SSCS Add\-On team is a product engineering team within GitLab’s Software Supply Chain Security stage. We work on key capabilities in the SSCS Add\-On SKU and collaborate closely with product and engineering partners to deliver security features for customers operating in regulated environments. You’ll report to the SSCS Senior Engineering Manager and partner directly with the Staff Backend Engineer and Product Manager. As a distributed team working asynchronously across regions, we are focused on strong delivery practices, team health, and scaling the product area with clarity and accountability.
